<script>(() => {
  'use strict';

  const ready = (callback) => {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', callback, { once: true });
    } else {
      callback();
    }
  };

  ready(() => {
    const body = document.body;
    const toggle = document.getElementById('adminFloatingToggle');
    const menu = document.getElementById('adminFloatingMenu');
    const backdrop = document.getElementById('adminNavBackdrop');

    if (toggle && menu) {
      const setOpen = (open) => {
        const next = Boolean(open);
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', next ? 'true' : 'false');
        menu.classList.toggle('is-open', next);
        menu.setAttribute('aria-hidden', next ? 'false' : 'true');
        backdrop?.classList.toggle('is-open', next);
        body?.classList.toggle('admin-nav-open', next);
      };

      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setOpen(toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
      });
      backdrop?.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false));
      menu.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) setOpen(false);
      });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
      });
      window.addEventListener('pageshow', () => setOpen(false));
    }

    // Mark existing scroll containers consistently without changing table markup.
    document.querySelectorAll('.table-wrap, .auditTableWrap, .table-responsive, .responsive-table, .table-container')
      .forEach((node) => node.classList.add('admin-scroll-region'));
  });
})();

</script>

<script>/* Shared Dashboard customer search: calculations intentionally retain Dashboard semantics. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const normalizeOpdKey = v => {
    const digits=String(v??'').trim().replace(/\D/g,'');
    if(!digits)return ''; const opd=digits.padStart(4,'0').slice(-4); return opd==='0000'?'':opd;
  };
  function indexRecords(records){
    const map=new Map();
    records.forEach(r=>{
      const opd=normalizeOpdKey(r.opd);
      const key=opd?`opd:${opd}`:`np:${String(r.name??'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').toLowerCase()}|${String(r.phone??'').replace(/\D/g,'')}`;
      if(!map.has(key))map.set(key,[]);map.get(key).push(r);
    });
    map.forEach(rows=>rows.sort((a,b)=>String(b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.date||''))));
    return map;
  }
  function query(records, filters={}){
    const {nameInput='',startDate='',endDate='',minTotal=0,maxTotal=Infinity,minVisits=0,maxVisits=Infinity,minAbsent=0,maxAbsent=Infinity,minAvg=0,maxAvg=Infinity,selectedProducts=[]}=filters;
    const grouped = {};
    const today = new Date();

    const allRecordsByCustomerKey = indexRecords(records);
    allRecordsByCustomerKey.forEach((records, key) => {
      grouped[key] = records.slice();
    });

    const results = Object.entries(grouped).map(([key, records]) => {
      const name = records[0].name;

      const totalVisits = records.length;
      const paidRecords = records.filter(r => parseFloat(r.amount || 0) > 0);
      const paidVisits = paidRecords.length;
      const totalAmount = paidRecords.reduce((sum, r) => sum + parseFloat(r.amount), 0);
      const averageBill = paidVisits > 0 ? totalAmount / paidVisits : 0;

      const latestRecord = records.reduce((latest, r) =>
        new Date(r.date) > new Date(latest.date) ? r : latest,
        records[0]
      );

      const absentDays = Math.floor((today - new Date(latestRecord.date)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      const lastVisit = latestRecord.date;

      const allProducts = records.flatMap(r => r.items || []).map(item => {
        const match = item.match(/\((.*?)\)/);
        return match ? match[1] : item.split(" - ")[0].trim();
      });

      return { key, name, opd: normalizeOpdKey(records[0]?.opd), totalAmount, totalVisits, paidVisits, averageBill, absentDays, lastVisit, products: allProducts };
    }).filter(c => {
      const nameMatch = !nameInput || c.name.toLowerCase().includes(nameInput);
      const totalMatch = c.totalAmount >= minTotal && c.totalAmount <= maxTotal;
      const visitMatch = c.totalVisits >= minVisits && c.totalVisits <= maxVisits;
      const absentMatch = c.absentDays >= minAbsent && c.absentDays <= maxAbsent;
      const avgMatch = c.averageBill >= minAvg && c.averageBill <= maxAvg;
      const dateMatch = (!startDate || new Date(c.lastVisit) >= new Date(startDate)) && (!endDate || new Date(c.lastVisit) <= new Date(endDate));
      const productMatch = selectedProducts.length === 0 || selectedProducts.every(p => c.products.some(prod => prod.includes(p)));
      return nameMatch && totalMatch && visitMatch && absentMatch && avgMatch && dateMatch && productMatch;
    }).sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);


    return results;
  }
  let cache=null,stamp=0,pending=null;
  function setRecords(records){if(Array.isArray(records)){cache=records;stamp=Date.now();}}
  async function load(){
    if(cache && Date.now()-stamp<60000)return cache;
    if(pending)return pending;
    pending=(async()=>{
      const res=await fetch('/api/sales',{credentials:'same-origin',headers:{Accept:'application/json'}});
      if(!res.ok)throw new Error('โหลดรายชื่อลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาลองใหม่');
      const data=await res.json();
      if(!Array.isArray(data))throw new Error('กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบใหม่ แล้วลองอีกครั้ง');
      setRecords(data);return data;
    })();
    try{return await pending;}finally{pending=null;}
  }
  window.SumoCustomerSearch={query,load,setRecords,indexRecords,products:{
    "โบทอค": ["Aestox 50 u", "Aestox 100 u", "Allergan 50 u", "Allergan 100 u"],
    "ฟิลเลอร์": ["Neuramis สีดำ", "Neuramis สีทอง", "E.P.T.Q", "Restylane"],
    "งานผิว": ["Meso Chanel", "P - Cell", "Aquatic", "Hestina", "Exosome", "Rejuran", "Belotero Revive", "Sculptra", "Juvelook", "Aesthefill"],
    "ดริปผิว": ["Snow White", "Super Aurawhite", "Vitamin Mix", "Brain Booster", "Energy Booster"],
    "ทรีทเม้นท์": ["ทรีทเมนต์หน้าใส", "ทรีทเมนต์สิว", "ทรีทเมนต์ฝ้า"],
    "ลดไขมัน": ["Bromi", "Sisi", "HIFU", "HIFU แถม"],
    "อื่นๆ": ["ยาฉีดสลายฝ้า", "ครีมทาฝ้า", "ยาทานฝ้า", "ไหมลิฟท์กรอบหน้า", "ไหม PDO", "ไหม Collagen"]
  }};
})();

</script>

  <div id="customer-modal" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="panel" id="customer-modal-box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" tabindex="-1">
      <div class="modal-head">
        <div class="modal-title" id="modalTitle">📇 ลูกค้า</div>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <div class="modal-tabs" id="modalTabs">
            <button class="modal-tab active" data-tab="overview" type="button">ภาพรวม</button>

          <button class="btn btn-icon" id="btnModalClose" type="button" title="ปิด">❌</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body" id="modalBody"></div>

  <script>
    // ===================== Utils =====================
    const $ = (q, p=document)=>p.querySelector(q);
    const $$ = (q, p=document)=>Array.from(p.querySelectorAll(q));
    const toastWrap = $('#toastWrap');

    const showToast = (msg, type='ok')=>{
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'toast' + (type==='warn' ? ' warn' : type==='error' ? ' error' : '');
      el.innerHTML = `<div>💡</div><div>${msg}</div>`;
      toastWrap.appendChild(el);
      setTimeout(()=>{ el.style.opacity='0'; el.style.transform='translateY(6px)'; }, 2400);
      setTimeout(()=>{ el.remove(); }, 3100);
    };

    const esc = s => String(s||'')
      .replaceAll('&','&amp;').replaceAll('<','&lt;').replaceAll('>','&gt;')
      .replaceAll('"','&quot;').replaceAll("'","&#039;");

    const pad4 = s => String(s ?? '').trim().padStart(4,'0');

    const todayISO = ()=> new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);

    const fmtShortDate = (iso)=>{
      if(!iso) return '-';
      try{
        const s = iso10(iso);
        if(!s) return '-';
        const [yyyy, mm, dd] = s.split('-');
        if(!yyyy || !mm || !dd) return String(iso).slice(0,10);
        return `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy}`;
      }catch{ return String(iso).slice(0,10); }
    };

    function setPlanDateValue(iso){
      const d = iso10(iso) || todayISO();
      if(planDate) planDate.value = d;
      if(planDateDisplay) planDateDisplay.value = fmtShortDate(d);
      if(planTitleDate) planTitleDate.textContent = fmtShortDate(d);
      if(todaySummaryDate) todaySummaryDate.textContent = fmtShortDate(d);
      return d;
    }

    const fmtMoney = (n)=>{
      const x = Math.round(Number(n||0));
      return x.toLocaleString();
    };

    const debounce = (fn, ms=300)=>{
      let t;
      return (...a)=>{
        clearTimeout(t);
        t = setTimeout(()=> fn(...a), ms);
      };
    };

    // ✅ normalize ให้เป็น YYYY-MM-DD เสมอ (รองรับทั้ง "YYYY-MM-DD" และ ISO8601 timestamp)
    const iso10 = (v)=>{
      const s = String(v || '').trim();
      return s ? s.slice(0,10) : '';
    };

    // ✅ daysBetween แบบไม่โดน timezone shift
    function daysBetween(aISO, bISO){
      const a10 = iso10(aISO);
      const b10 = iso10(bISO);
      if(!a10 || !b10) return null;

      const [ay,am,ad] = a10.split('-').map(Number);
      const [by,bm,bd] = b10.split('-').map(Number);
      if(!ay||!am||!ad||!by||!bm||!bd) return null;

      const aUTC = Date.UTC(ay, am-1, ad);
      const bUTC = Date.UTC(by, bm-1, bd);
      return Math.floor((bUTC - aUTC) / 86400000);
    }



    // ✅ CRM purchase history helper
    // หน้า CRM เดิมดึงประวัติซื้อจาก /api/reccord_sale อย่างเดียวและผูกด้วย OPD ตรง ๆ
    // แต่หน้าวิเคราะห์ใช้ /api/sales ซึ่ง normalize รายการได้ครบกว่า
    // ชุดนี้ทำให้ CRM ใช้ข้อมูลขายชุดเดียวกับหน้าวิเคราะห์ และ fallback ด้วยเบอร์/ชื่อเมื่อ OPD เก่าไม่ตรง
    function cleanOPDForRecord(v){
      const d = String(v ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      if(!d) return '';
      const opd = d.padStart(4,'0').slice(-4);
      return opd === '0000' ? '' : opd;
    }
    function normPhoneForRecord(v){
      let d = String(v ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      if(d.startsWith('66') && d.length >= 11) d = '0' + d.slice(-9);
      return d;
    }
    function normNameForRecord(v){
      return String(v ?? '').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').toLowerCase();
    }
    function stringifySaleItemForCRM(item){
      if(item == null) return '';
      if(typeof item === 'string') return item.trim();
      if(typeof item === 'object'){
        const label = String(item.label || item.name || item.item || item.product_name || '').trim();
        const qty = item.qty ?? item.quantity ?? item.count ?? '';
        const price = item.price ?? item.unit_price ?? item.amount ?? '';
        if(label && qty && price) return `${label} - ${qty} ชิ้น x ${price} บาท`;
        if(label && qty) return `${label} - ${qty} ชิ้น`;
        if(label) return label;
        try{ return JSON.stringify(item); }catch(e){ return String(item); }
      }
      return String(item).trim();
    }
    function parseSaleItemsForCRM(raw){
      if(raw == null || raw === '') return [];
      let val = raw;
      if(typeof val === 'string'){
        const t = val.trim();
        if(!t) return [];
        try{
          const parsed = JSON.parse(t);
          val = parsed;
        }catch(e){
          // รองรับข้อมูลเก่าที่เป็นข้อความหลายบรรทัด
          return t.split(/\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        }
      }
      if(Array.isArray(val)) return val.map(stringifySaleItemForCRM).filter(Boolean);
      return [stringifySaleItemForCRM(val)].filter(Boolean);
    }
    function normalizeSaleRecordForCRM(r){
      const out = {...(r || {})};
      out.opd = cleanOPDForRecord(out.opd);
      out.name = String(out.name || out.customer_name || out.full_name || '').trim();
      out.phone = String(out.phone || out.tel || out.mobile || '').trim();
      out.date = iso10(out.date || out.sale_date || out.created_at || out.updated_at || '');
      out.amount = Number(out.amount ?? out.total ?? out.total_amount ?? 0) || 0;
      out.items = parseSaleItemsForCRM(out.items ?? out.item ?? out.sale_items ?? out.products);
      return out;
    }
    async function loadSalesRecordsForCRM(){
      // ใช้ /api/sales ก่อน เพราะเป็น endpoint เดียวกับหน้าวิเคราะห์ที่ประวัติซื้อขึ้นครบ
      let arr = [];
      try{ arr = await fetchJSON('/api/sales'); }catch(e){ arr = []; }
      if(!Array.isArray(arr) || !arr.length){
        try{ arr = await fetchJSON('/api/reccord_sale'); }catch(e){ arr = []; }
      }
      return (Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []).map(normalizeSaleRecordForCRM);
    }
    function pushMapList(map, key, val){
      if(!key) return;
      if(!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
      map.get(key).push(val);
    }
    function sortSaleRecordsDesc(list){
      list.sort((a,b)=>{
        const ad = iso10(a?.date);
        const bd = iso10(b?.date);
        if(bd !== ad) return bd.localeCompare(ad);
        return String(b?.created_at || b?.date || '').localeCompare(String(a?.created_at || a?.date || ''));
      });
      return list;
    }
    function getPurchaseRecordsForCustomer(opd){
      const key = cleanOPDForRecord(opd);
      const cust = customerByOPD.get(key) || {opd:key, name:'', phone:''};
      const buckets = [];
      if(key && recordsByOPD.has(key)) buckets.push(recordsByOPD.get(key));
      const ph = normPhoneForRecord(cust.phone || '');
      if(ph && recordsByPhone.has(ph)) buckets.push(recordsByPhone.get(ph));
      const nm = normNameForRecord(cust.name || '');
      if(nm && recordsByName.has(nm)) buckets.push(recordsByName.get(nm));

      const seen = new Set();
      const merged = [];
      for(const list of buckets){
        for(const r of (list || [])){
          const rid = r.id || r.sale_id || `${r.date}|${r.opd}|${r.name}|${r.phone}|${r.amount}|${JSON.stringify(r.items || []).slice(0,180)}`;
          if(seen.has(rid)) continue;
          seen.add(rid);
          merged.push(r);
        }
      }
      return sortSaleRecordsDesc(merged);
    }

    function nowStamp(){
      const d = new Date();
      const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0');
      const mm = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }

    // ===================== Fetch helpers =====================
    async function fetchJSON(url, opt){
      const res = await fetch(url, opt);
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      return await res.json();
    }

    // ===================== Index builders =====================
    const NAME_COLOR_INFO = {
      green:  {label:'เขียว', icon:'🟢', cls:'opd-status-green'},
      orange: {label:'ส้ม', icon:'🟠', cls:'opd-status-orange'},
      red:    {label:'แดง', icon:'🔴', cls:'opd-status-red'},
      gold:   {label:'ทอง VIP', icon:'💎', cls:'opd-status-gold'}
    };
    function normalizeNameColor(v){
      const s = String(v || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if(['green','orange','red','gold'].includes(s)) return s;
      return 'green';
    }
    function nameColorInfo(v){
      const c = normalizeNameColor(v);
      return NAME_COLOR_INFO[c] || NAME_COLOR_INFO.green;
    }
    function getCustomerNameColor(opd){
      const c = customerByOPD.get(pad4(opd || ''));
      return normalizeNameColor(c?.name_color || c?.nameColor || c?.customer_color || 'green');
    }
    function customerOPDStatusBadge(opd, opts={}){
      const color = getCustomerNameColor(opd);
      const info = nameColorInfo(color);
      const label = opts.short && color !== 'gold' ? info.label : info.label;
      return `<span class="opd-status-chip ${info.cls}" title="สถานะจาก OPD: ${esc(info.label)}">${info.icon} ${esc(label)}</span>`;
    }
    function customerNameWithDiamond(name, opd){
      const color = getCustomerNameColor(opd);
      const suffix = color === 'gold' ? ' 💎' : '';
      return `${esc(name || opd || '-')}${suffix}`;
    }
    window.applyCustomerNameColors = function(root=document){
      const base = root || document;
      base.querySelectorAll?.('.customer-name-color[data-name-color-opd]').forEach(el=>{
        const color = getCustomerNameColor(el.getAttribute('data-name-color-opd') || '');
        el.classList.remove('name-green','name-orange','name-red','name-gold');
        el.classList.add(`name-${color}`);
        if(color === 'gold' && !/💎\s*$/.test(el.textContent || '')) el.textContent = `${el.textContent || ''} 💎`;
      });
    };

    function buildCustomerIndexes(){
      customerIndex = new Map();
      customerByOPD = new Map();
      for(const c of customers){
        const opd = pad4(c?.opd);
        const phone = String(c?.phone ?? '');
        const name = String(c?.name ?? '').trim();
        const name_color = normalizeNameColor(c?.name_color || c?.nameColor || c?.customer_color || c?.status_color || 'green');
        const label = name ? `${name} — ${opd}${phone?` / ${phone}`:''}` : opd;
        if(label) customerIndex.set(label, {opd, name, phone, name_color});
        if(opd) customerByOPD.set(opd, {...c, opd, name, phone, name_color});
      }
      const keys = Array.from(customerIndex.keys()).sort((a,b)=> a.localeCompare(b,'th'));
      dlCustomers.innerHTML = keys.map(k=> `<option value="${esc(k)}"></option>`).join('');
    }

    // ✅ ปรับ sort record ให้คอนซิสต์ แม้ date จะเป็น YYYY-MM-DD หรือ ISO timestamp
    function buildRecordsIndex(){
      recordsByOPD = new Map();
      recordsByPhone = new Map();
      recordsByName = new Map();

      records = (records || []).map(normalizeSaleRecordForCRM);

      for(const r of records){
        const opd = cleanOPDForRecord(r?.opd);
        const phone = normPhoneForRecord(r?.phone || '');
        const name = normNameForRecord(r?.name || '');

        if(opd) pushMapList(recordsByOPD, opd, r);
        if(phone) pushMapList(recordsByPhone, phone, r);
        if(name) pushMapList(recordsByName, name, r);
      }

      for(const list of recordsByOPD.values()) sortSaleRecordsDesc(list);
      for(const list of recordsByPhone.values()) sortSaleRecordsDesc(list);
      for(const list of recordsByName.values()) sortSaleRecordsDesc(list);
    }

    function buildPitchesIndex(){
      pitchesByOPD = new Map();
      for(const p of pitches){
        const opd = pad4(p?.opd);
        if(!opd) continue;
        if(!pitchesByOPD.has(opd)) pitchesByOPD.set(opd, []);
        pitchesByOPD.get(opd).push(p);
      }
      for(const [opd, list] of pitchesByOPD.entries()){
        list.sort((a,b)=> String(b.created_at||b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.created_at||a.date||'')));
      }
    }

   // ===================== Scoring & Segmentation =====================
const VIP_THRESHOLD = 15000;

// ✅ กติกาใหม่: คนเพิ่งมาไม่ควรโทรเร็วเกินไป
// - เพิ่งมาไม่ถึง 4 เดือน = ยังไม่แนะนำ
// - ถ้าโทรแล้วลูกค้ามาหลังจากนั้น = พักโทรจนกว่าจะครบ 6 เดือน
// - ไม่มาเกือบ 1 ปีครึ่ง = หยุดติดต่อ
const RECENT_VISIT_DAYS = 120;        // ~4 เดือน
const POST_CALL_VISIT_PAUSE_DAYS = 180; // ~6 เดือน
const LONG_ABSENT_STOP_DAYS = 540;    // ~1 ปีครึ่ง
const INACTIVE_DAYS = RECENT_VISIT_DAYS
const NO_CONTACT_PAT = /(ไม่รับสาย|ปิดเครื่อง|โทรไม่ติด|ติดต่อไม่ได้)/;
const SOFT_INTEREST_PAT = /(สนใจแต่ยังต้องตามต่อ|สนใจแต่ยังไม่ว่าง)/;
const STRONG_STOP_PAT = /(เบอร์ผิด|ไม่น่าจะกลับมาแล้ว|ไม่สนใจไม่บอกเหตุผล)/;
const CLEAR_REJECT_PAT = /(ไม่สนใจ)/;

const CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS = {
  CALL: 'ควรโทร',
  LATER: 'รอติดต่อภายหลัง',
  PAUSE: 'พักติดต่อ',
  STOP: 'หยุดติดต่อ'
};

function isNoContactOutcome(outcome){
  return NO_CONTACT_PAT.test(String(outcome || '').trim());
}
function isSoftInterestOutcome(outcome){
  return SOFT_INTEREST_PAT.test(String(outcome || '').trim());
}
function isStrongStopOutcome(outcome){
  return STRONG_STOP_PAT.test(String(outcome || '').trim());
}
function isClearRejectOutcome(outcome){
  return CLEAR_REJECT_PAT.test(String(outcome || '').trim());
}
function countLatestNoContactStreak(list){
  let n = 0;
  for(const p of (list || [])){
    if(isNoContactOutcome(p?.outcome)) n++;
    else break;
  }
  return n;
}
function countLatestSoftInterestStreak(list){
  let n = 0;
  for(const p of (list || [])){
    if(isSoftInterestOutcome(p?.outcome)) n++;
    else break;
  }
  return n;
}

function calcCustomerAnalytics(opd){
      const cust = customerByOPD.get(opd) || {opd, name:opd, phone:'', name_color:'green'};
      const nameColor = normalizeNameColor(cust.name_color || 'green');
      const pitchList = pitchesByOPD.get(opd) || [];
      const recList = getPurchaseRecordsForCustomer(opd);

      const paid = recList.filter(r=> Number(r.amount||0) > 0);
      const totalAmount = paid.reduce((s,r)=> s + Number(r.amount||0), 0);
      const paidVisits = paid.length;
      const avgAmount = paidVisits ? totalAmount/paidVisits : 0;
      const isHighValue = totalAmount >= VIP_THRESHOLD;

      // ✅ วันมาคลินิกล่าสุด ใช้ประวัติขาย/เข้ารับบริการล่าสุด ไม่ผูกกับยอดเงิน
      const lastBuyDate = recList[0]?.date ? iso10(recList[0].date) : '';

      // ✅ เก็บการโทรล่าสุดทั้งหมดไว้แสดงผล
      const overallAttempts = pitchList.length;
      const overallLastPitch = pitchList[0] || null;
      const overallLastPitchDate = overallLastPitch ? iso10(overallLastPitch.created_at||overallLastPitch.date||'') : '';
      const overallLastOutcome = overallLastPitch?.outcome || '';

      // ✅ เริ่มรอบติดตามใหม่หลังวันที่ลูกค้ามาครั้งล่าสุด
      const scoringPitchList = lastBuyDate
        ? pitchList.filter(p => iso10(p.created_at||p.date||'') > lastBuyDate)
        : pitchList;

      const attempts = scoringPitchList.length;
      const salePitchAttempts = scoringPitchList.filter(p => !isFollowupLog(p)).length;
      const followupAttempts = scoringPitchList.filter(p => isFollowupLog(p)).length;
      const overallSalePitchAttempts = pitchList.filter(p => !isFollowupLog(p)).length;
      const overallFollowupAttempts = pitchList.filter(p => isFollowupLog(p)).length;
      const lastPitch = scoringPitchList[0] || null;
      const lastPitchDate = lastPitch ? iso10(lastPitch.created_at||lastPitch.date||'') : '';
      const lastOutcome = lastPitch?.outcome || '';
      const everInterested = scoringPitchList.some(p=> isInterested(p.outcome));

      // ✅ วิเคราะห์ลำดับเหตุการณ์หลังคำว่า “สนใจ”
      const interestedPitches = scoringPitchList.filter(p => isInterested(p.outcome));
      const interestAttempts = interestedPitches.length;
      const latestInterestedPitch = interestedPitches[0] || null;
      const latestInterestedDate = latestInterestedPitch ? iso10(latestInterestedPitch.created_at||latestInterestedPitch.date||'') : '';
      const followupsAfterInterest = latestInterestedDate
        ? scoringPitchList.filter(p => iso10(p.created_at||p.date||'') > latestInterestedDate)
        : [];
      const followupAfterInterestCount = followupsAfterInterest.length;
      const lastInterestedDate = latestInterestedDate;

      const latestNoContact = isNoContactOutcome(lastOutcome);
      const latestSoftInterest = isSoftInterestOutcome(lastOutcome);
      const latestStrongStop = isStrongStopOutcome(lastOutcome);
      const latestClearReject = isClearRejectOutcome(lastOutcome);
      const noContactStreak = countLatestNoContactStreak(scoringPitchList);
      const softInterestStreak = countLatestSoftInterestStreak(scoringPitchList);
      const calledToday = !!(overallLastPitchDate && overallLastPitchDate === todayISO());

      const hadPitchBeforeOrOnLastBuy = !!(lastBuyDate && pitchList.some(p => iso10(p.created_at||p.date||'') <= lastBuyDate));
      const hasPostBuyFollowup = attempts > 0;

      const daysSincePitch = lastPitchDate ? daysBetween(lastPitchDate, todayISO()) : null;
      const daysSinceBuy = lastBuyDate ? daysBetween(lastBuyDate, todayISO()) : null;
      const cameRecently = (daysSinceBuy !== null && daysSinceBuy < RECENT_VISIT_DAYS);
      const longAbsentStop = (daysSinceBuy !== null && daysSinceBuy >= LONG_ABSENT_STOP_DAYS);

      const visitedAfterPitch = hadPitchBeforeOrOnLastBuy;
      const visitedAfterLatestPitch = !!(overallLastPitchDate && lastBuyDate && overallLastPitchDate <= lastBuyDate);
      const suppressTopPriority = hadPitchBeforeOrOnLastBuy && !hasPostBuyFollowup;
      const postCallVisitStillCooling = !!(hadPitchBeforeOrOnLastBuy && !hasPostBuyFollowup && daysSinceBuy !== null && daysSinceBuy < POST_CALL_VISIT_PAUSE_DAYS);
      const visitedRecently = visitedAfterLatestPitch && (daysSinceBuy !== null && daysSinceBuy <= 1);

      // ✅ เคยสนใจ แต่ตามอีก 2 ครั้งแล้วยังไม่มา = พัก ไม่ดันโทรต่อ
      const interestedThenFollowedNoVisit = !!(
        everInterested &&
        !latestNoContact &&
        (
          followupAfterInterestCount >= 2 ||
          (interestAttempts >= 2 && latestSoftInterest) ||
          softInterestStreak >= 2
        )
      );

      let priority = 0;
      let bucket = 'Cold';
      let recommend = 'ค่อยโทร';
      let callReason = '';
      let contactStatus = 'CALL';
      let contactStatusReason = '';

      // ✅ 1) หยุดติดต่อ: ไม่ควรเสียเวลาโทรต่อ
      if(latestStrongStop){
        contactStatus = 'STOP';
        contactStatusReason = lastOutcome.includes('เบอร์ผิด') ? 'เบอร์ผิด' : 'ปฏิเสธชัดเจน';
      }
      else if(longAbsentStop){
        contactStatus = 'STOP';
        contactStatusReason = `ไม่มาเกือบ 1 ปีครึ่ง (${daysSinceBuy} วัน)`;
      }
      // ✅ 2) พัก/รอหลังลูกค้ามาแล้ว: กันเคสโทรแล้วลูกค้ามา แต่ระบบยังดันให้โทรซ้ำ
      else if(postCallVisitStillCooling){
        contactStatus = 'LATER';
        contactStatusReason = `มาแล้วหลังการโทร พักโทรจนกว่าจะครบ 6 เดือน (ตอนนี้ ${daysSinceBuy} วัน)`;
      }
      else if(cameRecently){
        contactStatus = 'LATER';
        contactStatusReason = `เพิ่งมาไม่ถึง 4 เดือน (${daysSinceBuy} วัน)`;
      }
      else if(visitedAfterLatestPitch && !hasPostBuyFollowup){
        contactStatus = 'LATER';
        contactStatusReason = 'มาแล้วหลังโทรล่าสุด';
      }
      else if(suppressTopPriority && daysSinceBuy !== null && daysSinceBuy < POST_CALL_VISIT_PAUSE_DAYS){
        contactStatus = 'LATER';
        contactStatusReason = `ซื้อ/มาแล้วหลังโทร พักถึงครบ 6 เดือน`;
      }
      // ✅ 3) พักติดต่อ: เสียเวลาสูง/ตามแล้วไม่เกิด action
      else if(latestNoContact && noContactStreak >= 3){
        contactStatus = 'PAUSE';
        contactStatusReason = `ติดต่อไม่ได้ ${noContactStreak} ครั้งติด`;
      }
      else if(interestedThenFollowedNoVisit){
        contactStatus = 'PAUSE';
        contactStatusReason = 'เคยสนใจ แต่ตามอีก 2 ครั้งแล้วยังไม่มา';
      }
      else if(latestClearReject){
        contactStatus = 'PAUSE';
        contactStatusReason = 'ปฏิเสธล่าสุด';
      }
      else if(!everInterested && attempts >= 3 && !latestNoContact){
        contactStatus = 'PAUSE';
        contactStatusReason = 'โทรหลายครั้งแล้วยังไม่เกิดสัญญาณสนใจ';
      }
      // ✅ 4) รอภายหลัง: ไม่ควรโทรตอนนี้ แต่ไม่ใช่ลูกค้าที่ควรทิ้ง
      else if(calledToday){
        contactStatus = 'LATER';
        contactStatusReason = 'โทรไปแล้ววันนี้';
      }
      else if(latestNoContact && noContactStreak < 3){
        contactStatus = 'LATER';
        contactStatusReason = `ล่าสุดติดต่อไม่ได้ ${noContactStreak} ครั้ง ยังโทรซ้ำได้ภายหลัง`;
      }
      // ✅ 5) ควรโทรจริง
      else{
        contactStatus = 'CALL';
        if(isHighValue && daysSinceBuy !== null && daysSinceBuy >= 180) contactStatusReason = `ลูกค้ามูลค่าสูง + ไม่ได้มา ${daysSinceBuy} วัน`;
        else if(isInterested(lastOutcome)) contactStatusReason = 'ล่าสุดสนใจ ยังไม่มีการมาหลังจากนั้น';
        else if(everInterested) contactStatusReason = 'เคยสนใจและยังไม่ถูกตามซ้ำเกินควร';
        else if(attempts === 0 && daysSinceBuy !== null) contactStatusReason = `ยังไม่เคยโทร + ไม่ได้มา ${daysSinceBuy} วัน`;
        else if(daysSinceBuy !== null && daysSinceBuy >= RECENT_VISIT_DAYS) contactStatusReason = `ไม่ได้มา ${daysSinceBuy} วัน`;
        else contactStatusReason = 'เข้าเงื่อนไขติดตาม';
      }

      // คะแนนคำนวณเฉพาะคนที่ควรโทรจริง
      if(contactStatus === 'CALL'){
        let sInterest = 0;
        if(everInterested) sInterest += 18;
        if(isInterested(lastOutcome)) sInterest += 22;

        let sRecency = 0;
        if(daysSincePitch === null) sRecency = 12;
        else{
          if(daysSincePitch < 2) sRecency = 4;
          else if(daysSincePitch < 7) sRecency = 10;
          else if(daysSincePitch <= 21) sRecency = 20;
          else if(daysSincePitch <= 45) sRecency = 16;
          else sRecency = 12;
        }

        let sAttempts = 0;
        if(attempts === 0) sAttempts = 14;
        else if(attempts === 1) sAttempts = 15;
        else if(attempts === 2) sAttempts = 10;
        else sAttempts = 4;

        let sValue = 0;
        if(totalAmount <= 0) sValue = 4;
        else{
          const x = Math.log10(totalAmount + 1);
          sValue = Math.max(6, Math.min(25, Math.round((x - 3) * 12 + 10)));
        }

        priority = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Math.round(sInterest + sRecency + sAttempts + sValue)));
        if(priority >= 70){ bucket = 'Hot'; recommend = 'โทรวันนี้'; }
        else if(priority >= 50){ bucket = 'Warm'; recommend = 'ตามต่อ'; }
        else { bucket = 'Cold'; recommend = 'ค่อยโทร'; }
        callReason = contactStatusReason;
      }else{
        priority = 0;
        if(contactStatus === 'LATER'){ bucket = 'Warm'; recommend = 'รอภายหลัง'; }
        else if(contactStatus === 'PAUSE'){ bucket = 'Cold'; recommend = 'พักติดต่อ'; }
        else { bucket = 'Stop'; recommend = 'หยุดติดต่อ'; }
        callReason = contactStatusReason;
      }

      if(nameColor === 'gold'){
        contactStatus = 'PAUSE';
        contactStatusReason = 'VIP สีทอง: หมอดูแลเอง / ห้ามเซลแตะต้อง';
        priority = 0;
        bucket = 'Owner';
        recommend = 'หมอดูแลเอง';
        callReason = contactStatusReason;
      }

      const isCallCandidate = contactStatus === 'CALL' && priority > 0;
      const segment = contactStatus; // ใช้ field เดิม แต่เปลี่ยนนิยามใหม่ให้เข้าใจง่าย
      const callBlockReason = contactStatus === 'CALL' ? '' : contactStatusReason;

      return {
        opd,
        name: cust.name || opd,
        phone: cust.phone || '',
        nameColor,
        totalAmount,
        paidVisits,
        avgAmount,
        lastBuyDate,
        attempts,
        salePitchAttempts,
        followupAttempts,
        overallAttempts,
        overallSalePitchAttempts,
        overallFollowupAttempts,
        lastPitchDate: overallLastPitchDate,
        scoringLastPitchDate: lastPitchDate,
        lastOutcome: overallLastOutcome,
        scoringLastOutcome: lastOutcome,
        everInterested,
        lastInterestedDate,
        followupAfterInterestCount,
        interestAttempts,
        latestNoContact,
        noContactStreak,
        calledToday,
        interestedThenFollowedNoVisit,
        daysSincePitch,
        daysSinceBuy,
        cameRecently,
        longAbsentStop,
        postCallVisitStillCooling,
        priority,
        segment,
        contactStatus,
        contactStatusReason,
        isHighValue,
        bucket,
        recommend,
        callReason,
        visitedAfterPitch,
        visitedAfterLatestPitch,
        visitedRecently,
        suppressTopPriority,
        hasPostBuyFollowup,
        callBlockReason,
        isCallCandidate
      };
    }

    function rebuildAnalytics(){
      const opds = new Set();
      for(const c of customers) opds.add(pad4(c?.opd));
      for(const p of pitches) opds.add(pad4(p?.opd));
      for(const r of records){ const ropd = cleanOPDForRecord(r?.opd); if(ropd) opds.add(ropd); }

      analytics = Array.from(opds)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map(opd => calcCustomerAnalytics(opd));

      analytics.sort((a,b)=> (b.priority - a.priority) || (b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount) || (String(b.lastPitchDate||'').localeCompare(a.lastPitchDate||'')));
    }

    // ===================== Charts =====================
    function buildOutcomeChart(list){
      const freq = new Map();
      for(const p of list){
        const k = String(p.outcome||'').trim() || '(ไม่ระบุ)';
        freq.set(k, (freq.get(k)||0) + 1);
      }
      const arr = Array.from(freq.entries()).sort((a,b)=> b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,8);
      const labels = arr.map(x=> x[0]);
      const data = arr.map(x=> x[1]);

      const ctx = document.getElementById('chartOutcomes').getContext('2d');
      if(chartOutcomes) chartOutcomes.destroy();
      chartOutcomes = new Chart(ctx, {
        type:'bar',
        data:{ labels, datasets:[{ label:'จำนวน', data }] },
        options:{
          responsive:true,
          plugins:{ legend:{ display:false } },
          scales:{
            x:{ ticks:{ maxRotation:0, minRotation:0 } },
            y:{ beginAtZero:true }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function buildFunnelChart(listAnalytics){
      const buckets = {CALL:0, LATER:0, PAUSE:0, STOP:0};
      for(const a of listAnalytics){
        const k = a.segment || a.contactStatus || 'CALL';
        buckets[k] = (buckets[k]||0) + 1;
      }
      const labels = ['ควรโทร','รอภายหลัง','พักติดต่อ','หยุดติดต่อ'];
      const data = [buckets.CALL||0, buckets.LATER||0, buckets.PAUSE||0, buckets.STOP||0];

      const ctx = document.getElementById('chartFunnel').getContext('2d');
      if(chartFunnel) chartFunnel.destroy();
      chartFunnel = new Chart(ctx, {
        type:'bar',
        data:{ labels, datasets:[{ label:'จำนวนลูกค้า', data }] },
        options:{
          responsive:true,
          plugins:{ legend:{ display:false } },
          scales:{ y:{ beginAtZero:true } }
        }
      });
    }

    // ===================== Rendering =====================
    function segBadge(seg){
      if(seg==='CALL') return `<span class="badge b-green">ควรโทร</span>`;
      if(seg==='LATER') return `<span class="badge b-amber">รอติดต่อภายหลัง</span>`;
      if(seg==='PAUSE') return `<span class="badge b-slate">พักติดต่อ</span>`;
      if(seg==='STOP') return `<span class="badge b-red">หยุดติดต่อ</span>`;
      return `<span class="badge b-slate">${esc(seg || '-')}</span>`;
    }

    function valueBadge(a){
      return a?.isHighValue ? `<span class="badge b-green">VIP/มูลค่าสูง</span>` : '';
    }

    function renderRecommend(a){
      if(a.segment==='CALL'){
        if(a.bucket==='Hot') return `<span class="badge b-green">โทรวันนี้</span>`;
        if(a.bucket==='Warm') return `<span class="badge b-amber">ตามต่อ</span>`;
        return `<span class="badge b-slate">ค่อยโทร</span>`;
      }
      if(a.segment==='LATER') return `<span class="badge b-amber">รอภายหลัง</span>`;
      if(a.segment==='PAUSE') return `<span class="badge b-slate">พักติดต่อ</span>`;
      return `<span class="badge b-red">หยุดติดต่อ</span>`;
    }



    function getSegmentCounts(list){
      const counts = {CALL:0, LATER:0, PAUSE:0, STOP:0};
      const vipCounts = {CALL:0, LATER:0, PAUSE:0, STOP:0};
      for(const a of (list || [])){
        const k = a.segment || a.contactStatus || 'CALL';
        if(counts[k] === undefined) counts[k] = 0;
        counts[k]++;
        if(a.isHighValue){
          if(vipCounts[k] === undefined) vipCounts[k] = 0;
          vipCounts[k]++;
        }
      }
      return {counts, vipCounts};
    }

    function segmentInfo(seg){
      const map = {
        CALL:  {label:'ควรโทร', icon:'☎️', cls:'b-green', hint:'กลุ่มที่ควรเอาเข้าคิวโทร'},
        LATER: {label:'รอติดต่อภายหลัง', icon:'⏳', cls:'b-amber', hint:'เพิ่งมา/โทรวันนี้/ยังไม่ควรโทรตอนนี้'},
        PAUSE: {label:'พักติดต่อ', icon:'⏸️', cls:'b-slate', hint:'ตามแล้วไม่คุ้ม หรือยังไม่ควรตามต่อ'},
        STOP:  {label:'หยุดติดต่อ', icon:'🛑', cls:'b-red', hint:'ปฏิเสธชัดเจน/เบอร์ผิด/หายเกินเกณฑ์'}
      };
      return map[seg] || {label:seg || '-', icon:'•', cls:'b-slate', hint:''};
    }

    function renderSegmentDashboard(){
      if(!segmentKpis) return;
      const {counts, vipCounts} = getSegmentCounts(analytics);
      const total = Math.max(analytics.length, 1);
      const activeSeg = dashSegment?.value || '';
      const order = ['CALL','LATER','PAUSE','STOP'];

      segmentKpis.innerHTML = order.map(seg=>{
        const info = segmentInfo(seg);
        const n = counts[seg] || 0;
        const pct = Math.round(n * 1000 / total) / 10;
        const vip = vipCounts[seg] || 0;
        return `
          <div class="kpi segment-card ${activeSeg===seg?'active':''}" data-dash-segment="${seg}" title="คลิกเพื่อกรอง: ${esc(info.label)}">
            <div class="label">${info.icon} ${esc(info.label)}</div>
            <div class="value-row">
              <div class="value mono">${n.toLocaleString()}</div>
              <div class="pct mono">${pct}%</div>
            </div>
            <div class="hint">${esc(info.hint)}${vip ? ` • VIP ${vip.toLocaleString()} คน` : ''}</div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function filterAnalyticsForDash(list){
      const q = (dashQ.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
      const seg = dashSegment.value || '';
      let out = list;

      if(seg) out = out.filter(a=> a.segment === seg);
      if(q){
        out = out.filter(a=>{
          return (
            String(a.opd).toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            String(a.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            String(a.phone||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)
          );
        });
      }
      return out;
    }

    function renderDashboard(){
      kpiCustomers.textContent = analytics.length.toString();
      kpiPitches.textContent = pitches.length.toString();
      kpiInterested.textContent = pitches.filter(p=> isInterested(p.outcome)).length.toString();

      const total = pitches.length || 1;
      const interested = pitches.filter(p=> isInterested(p.outcome)).length;
      const rate = interested / total;
      const avgPriority = analytics.length ? analytics.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.priority,0)/analytics.length : 0;
      const conv = Math.round(rate*60 + avgPriority*0.4);
      kpiConvScore.textContent = `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, conv))}`;

      renderSegmentDashboard();

      const f = dashFrom.value || '';
      const t = dashTo.value || '';
      dashRange.textContent = (f||t) ? `${f||'—'} ถึง ${t||'—'}` : 'ทั้งหมด';

      buildOutcomeChart(pitches);
      buildFunnelChart(analytics);

      const filtered = filterAnalyticsForDash(analytics);
      const top = filtered.filter(a => a.isCallCandidate).slice(0, 30);

      dashTopTbody.innerHTML = top.map((a, i)=>`
        <tr>
          <td class="mono">${i+1}</td>
          <td>
            <a class="link customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(a.opd)}" data-open-profile="${esc(a.opd)}">${esc(a.name)}</a>
            <div class="compact-muted">OPD <span class="mono">${esc(a.opd)}</span>${a.phone?` • ${esc(a.phone)}`:''} • ${customerOPDStatusBadge(a.opd)}</div>
            <div style="margin-top:4px;" class="compact-status-line">${valueBadge(a)}</div>
          </td>
          <td>${segBadge(a.segment)}</td>
          <td class="right mono"><strong>${a.priority}</strong></td>
          <td class="right mono">${fmtMoney(a.totalAmount)}</td>
          <td class="right mono">${a.lastPitchDate ? fmtShortDate(a.lastPitchDate) : '-'}</td>
          <td>${a.lastOutcome ? `<span class="badge b-slate">${esc(a.lastOutcome)}</span>` : '-'}</td>
          <td class="right mono">${a.attempts}<div style="font-size:10px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;">S ${a.salePitchAttempts||0} / F ${a.followupAttempts||0}</div></td>
          <td>${renderRecommend(a)}</td>
          <td style="min-width:190px;color:#334155;font-weight:800;">${esc(a.callReason || '-')}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="10" style="padding:14px; color:#64748b;">ไม่มีลูกค้าที่ควรโทรตามเงื่อนไขนี้</td></tr>`;
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.(dashTopTbody);
    }



    // ===================== วิเคราะห์จากอริส: Campaign Intelligence =====================
    function customerMetaForAlice(a){
      return customerByOPD.get(a.opd) || {};
    }
    function birthMonthMatchesThisMonth(v){
      const raw = String(v || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if(!raw) return false;
      const m = new Date().getMonth() + 1;
      const nums = raw.match(/\d{1,2}/g) || [];
      if(nums.some(x => Number(x) === m)) return true;
      const th = ['','มกราคม','กุมภาพันธ์','มีนาคม','เมษายน','พฤษภาคม','มิถุนายน','กรกฎาคม','สิงหาคม','กันยายน','ตุลาคม','พฤศจิกายน','ธันวาคม'];
      const thShort = ['','ม.ค.','ก.พ.','มี.ค.','เม.ย.','พ.ค.','มิ.ย.','ก.ค.','ส.ค.','ก.ย.','ต.ค.','พ.ย.','ธ.ค.'];
      return raw.includes(th[m]) || raw.includes(thShort[m]);
    }
    function aliceTextBlob(a){
      const cust = customerMetaForAlice(a);
      const recs = getPurchaseRecordsForCustomer(a.opd).slice(0, 8);
      const recText = recs.map(r => `${(r.items||[]).join(' ')} ${r.note||''} ${r.payment||''}`).join(' ');
      const pitchText = (pitchesByOPD.get(a.opd)||[]).slice(0,8).map(p => `${p.promotion||''} ${p.outcome||''} ${p.content||''}`).join(' ');
      return `${recText} ${pitchText} ${cust.note||''} ${cust.profile||''} ${cust.vip||''}`.toLowerCase();
    }
    function aliceServiceTags(a){
      const blob = aliceTextBlob(a);
      const tags = [];
      if(/botox|โบท็อก|โบทอก|โบท็อกซ์|โบtox|\bโบ\b/.test(blob)) tags.push('botox');
      if(/filler|ฟิลเลอร์|restylane|neuramis|juvederm|ใต้ตา|คาง|ร่องแก้ม/.test(blob)) tags.push('filler');
      if(/meso|เมโส|chanel|ชาแนล|ผิว|หน้าใส|วิตามิน|drip|ดริป|biocollagen|prp|exosome|exo|รีจูรัน|rejuran/.test(blob)) tags.push('skin');
      if(/hifu|ulthera|ยกกระชับ|กรอบหน้า/.test(blob)) tags.push('lift');
      if(/fat|แฟต|ลดแก้ม|เหนียง/.test(blob)) tags.push('fat');
      return Array.from(new Set(tags));
    }
    function aliceHardStop(a){
      return a.segment === 'STOP' || isStrongStopOutcome(a.lastOutcome) || /เบอร์ผิด/.test(String(a.lastOutcome||''));
    }
    function aliceActionClass(action){
      if(action === 'โทร') return 'alice-action-call';
      if(action === 'LINE/แชท') return 'alice-action-line';
      if(action === 'แคมเปญ') return 'alice-action-campaign';
      if(action === 'พักเบอร์') return 'alice-action-pause';
      if(action === 'เจ้าของดูเอง') return 'alice-action-owner';
      if(action === 'หยุด') return 'alice-action-stop';
      return 'alice-action-campaign';
    }
    function aliceActionFor(a, campaignId){
      if(campaignId === 'call_ready') return 'โทร';
      if(campaignId === 'vip_owner') return 'เจ้าของดูเอง';
      if(campaignId === 'no_more_calls') return aliceHardStop(a) ? 'หยุด' : 'พักเบอร์';
      if(a.segment === 'CALL' && a.priority >= 55) return 'โทร';
      if(a.segment === 'PAUSE' || a.segment === 'LATER') return 'LINE/แชท';
      return 'แคมเปญ';
    }
    function aliceReasonFor(a, campaignId){
      const tags = aliceServiceTags(a);
      const bits = [];
      if(a.daysSinceBuy !== null && a.daysSinceBuy !== undefined) bits.push(`ไม่ได้มา ${a.daysSinceBuy} วัน`);
      if(a.attempts) bits.push(`ตามรอบนี้แล้ว ${a.attempts} ครั้ง`);
      if(a.lastOutcome) bits.push(`ล่าสุด: ${a.lastOutcome}`);
      if(tags.length) bits.push(`บริการ: ${tags.join(', ')}`);
      if(a.isHighValue) bits.push(`มูลค่าสูง ${fmtMoney(a.totalAmount)}`);
      if(campaignId === 'call_ready') return a.callReason || a.contactStatusReason || bits.join(' • ') || 'เข้าเงื่อนไขโทรจากคะแนนเดิม';
      if(campaignId === 'no_more_calls') return a.contactStatusReason || bits.join(' • ') || 'ถูกติดตามหลายครั้งแล้ว ไม่ควรจี้ซ้ำ';
      if(campaignId === 'vip_owner') return `ลูกค้ามูลค่าสูง${a.daysSinceBuy ? ` + หาย ${a.daysSinceBuy} วัน` : ''}${a.attempts ? ` + ถูกตาม ${a.attempts} ครั้ง` : ''}`;
      if(campaignId === 'botox_refresh') return `เคยมีบริการ Botox/โบท็อกซ์ + ${a.daysSinceBuy || '-'} วันหลังมาล่าสุด`;
      if(campaignId === 'skin_boost') return `เคยมีงานผิว/เมโส/ดริป/PRP/รีจูรัน + ${a.daysSinceBuy || '-'} วันหลังมาล่าสุด`;
      if(campaignId === 'filler_check') return `เคยมีฟิลเลอร์/ประเมินทรง + ${a.daysSinceBuy || '-'} วันหลังมาล่าสุด`;
      if(campaignId === 'birthday') return 'เดือนเกิดจาก customers.birthMonth';
      return bits.join(' • ') || '-';
    }
    const ALICE_CAMPAIGNS = [
      {id:'call_ready', icon:'☎️', name:'โทรได้จริง', hint:'ใช้ลิสต์นี้เฉพาะคนที่คะแนนเดิมบอกว่า CALL และยังไม่เหนื่อยจากการถูกตาม', action:'โทร'},
      {id:'no_more_calls', icon:'⛔', name:'ห้ามจี้ซ้ำ', hint:'ถูกตามหลายรอบ/พัก/หยุด แล้วควรออกจากงานโทรรายวัน', action:'พักเบอร์'},
      {id:'vip_owner', icon:'👑', name:'VIP/มูลค่าสูง', hint:'ยอดรวมสูง ควรใช้ข้อความพิเศษหรือเจ้าของดูเอง ไม่ใช่ให้เซลโทรมั่ว', action:'เจ้าของดูเอง'},
      {id:'botox_refresh', icon:'💉', name:'Botox Refresh', hint:'เคยทำ/สนใจโบท็อกซ์ และครบช่วงกลับมาดูแล', action:'แคมเปญ'},
      {id:'skin_boost', icon:'✨', name:'งานผิว/เมโส', hint:'เคยทำงานผิว เมโส ดริป PRP รีจูรัน หรือบริการฟื้นฟูผิว', action:'แคมเปญ'},
      {id:'filler_check', icon:'💎', name:'Filler Check', hint:'เคยทำ/สนใจฟิลเลอร์ เหมาะกับแคมเปญประเมินทรง/เติมจุดเล็ก', action:'แคมเปญ'},
      {id:'birthday', icon:'🎂', name:'Birthday', hint:'มี birthMonth ตรงเดือนนี้ ใช้สิทธิ์ลูกค้าเก่า/วันเกิด', action:'LINE/แชท'}
    ];
    function aliceRowsForCampaign(campaignId){
      return analytics.filter(a=>{
        const tags = aliceServiceTags(a);
        const cust = customerMetaForAlice(a);
        const days = Number(a.daysSinceBuy ?? 99999);
        if(campaignId === 'call_ready') return a.segment === 'CALL' && a.priority > 0;
        if(campaignId === 'no_more_calls') return (a.segment === 'PAUSE' || a.segment === 'STOP' || (a.attempts >= 3 && !a.visitedAfterLatestPitch));
        if(campaignId === 'vip_owner') return a.isHighValue && !aliceHardStop(a) && (days >= 120 || a.attempts >= 2 || a.segment !== 'CALL');
        if(campaignId === 'botox_refresh') return tags.includes('botox') && !aliceHardStop(a) && days >= 120;
        if(campaignId === 'skin_boost') return tags.includes('skin') && !aliceHardStop(a) && days >= 60;
        if(campaignId === 'filler_check') return tags.includes('filler') && !aliceHardStop(a) && days >= 180;
        if(campaignId === 'birthday') return birthMonthMatchesThisMonth(cust.birthMonth || cust.birth_month || '') && !aliceHardStop(a);
        return false;
      });
    }
    function sortAliceRows(rows){
      const sort = aliceSort?.value || 'value_desc';
      const out = [...rows];
      if(sort === 'value_desc') out.sort((a,b)=> (b.totalAmount-a.totalAmount) || (b.priority-a.priority));
      else if(sort === 'priority_desc') out.sort((a,b)=> (b.priority-a.priority) || (b.totalAmount-a.totalAmount));
      else if(sort === 'attempts_desc') out.sort((a,b)=> (b.attempts-a.attempts) || (b.totalAmount-a.totalAmount));
      else if(sort === 'last_buy_asc') out.sort((a,b)=> (Number(b.daysSinceBuy||0)-Number(a.daysSinceBuy||0)) || (b.totalAmount-a.totalAmount));
      return out;
    }
    function renderAliceKpis(){
      if(!aliceKpis) return;
      const call = aliceRowsForCampaign('call_ready');
      const noCall = aliceRowsForCampaign('no_more_calls');
      const vip = aliceRowsForCampaign('vip_owner');
      const campable = new Set();
      ['botox_refresh','skin_boost','filler_check','birthday'].forEach(id=> aliceRowsForCampaign(id).forEach(a=>campable.add(a.opd)));
      const noCallValue = noCall.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.totalAmount,0);
      aliceKpis.innerHTML = `
        <div class="kpi"><div class="label">โทรได้จริง</div><div class="value mono">${call.length.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="hint">จาก segment CALL เดิม</div></div>
        <div class="kpi"><div class="label">ห้ามจี้ซ้ำ</div><div class="value mono">${noCall.length.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="hint">พัก/หยุด/ตามหลายรอบแล้ว</div></div>
        <div class="kpi"><div class="label">ทำแคมเปญได้</div><div class="value mono">${campable.size.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="hint">มีเหตุผลจากบริการ/วันเกิด</div></div>
        <div class="kpi"><div class="label">มูลค่ากลุ่มห้ามจี้</div><div class="value mono">${fmtMoney(noCallValue)}</div><div class="hint">ไม่ควรเสียด้วยการโทรถี่</div></div>
      `;
    }
    function renderAliceCampaignCards(){
      if(!aliceCampaignGrid) return;
      aliceCampaignGrid.innerHTML = ALICE_CAMPAIGNS.map(c=>{
        const rows = aliceRowsForCampaign(c.id);
        const val = rows.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.totalAmount,0);
        return `
          <div class="alice-card ${aliceSelectedCampaign===c.id?'active':''}" data-alice-campaign="${c.id}">
            <div class="top">
              <div class="name">${c.icon} ${esc(c.name)}</div>
              <div class="num mono">${rows.length.toLocaleString()}</div>
            </div>
            <div><span class="alice-action-badge ${aliceActionClass(c.action)}">${esc(c.action)}</span></div>
            <div class="money mono">มูลค่ารวม ${fmtMoney(val)}</div>
            <div class="hint">${esc(c.hint)}</div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }
    function renderAliceSelected(){
      if(!aliceTbody) return;
      const campaign = ALICE_CAMPAIGNS.find(c=>c.id===aliceSelectedCampaign) || ALICE_CAMPAIGNS[0];
      const rows = sortAliceRows(aliceRowsForCampaign(campaign.id));
      aliceCurrentRows = rows;
      const totalValue = rows.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.totalAmount,0);
      if(aliceSelectedTitle) aliceSelectedTitle.textContent = `${campaign.icon} ${campaign.name}`;
      if(aliceSelectedHint) aliceSelectedHint.textContent = campaign.hint;
      if(aliceSelectedCount) aliceSelectedCount.textContent = rows.length.toLocaleString();
      if(aliceSelectedValue) aliceSelectedValue.textContent = fmtMoney(totalValue);
      aliceTbody.innerHTML = rows.slice(0,80).map((a,i)=>{
        const action = aliceActionFor(a, campaign.id);
        const reason = aliceReasonFor(a, campaign.id);
        return `
          <tr>
            <td class="mono">${i+1}</td>
            <td>
              <a class="link customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(a.opd)}" data-open-profile="${esc(a.opd)}">${esc(a.name)}</a>
              <div class="alice-row-note">OPD <span class="mono">${esc(a.opd)}</span>${a.phone?` • ${esc(a.phone)}`:''} • ${customerOPDStatusBadge(a.opd)}</div>
              ${a.isHighValue ? '<div style="margin-top:4px;"><span class="badge b-green">มูลค่าสูง</span></div>' : ''}
            </td>
            <td>
              <span class="alice-action-badge ${aliceActionClass(action)}">${esc(action)}</span>
              <div class="alice-row-note">${esc(campaign.name)}</div>
            </td>
            <td style="min-width:230px;color:#334155;font-weight:800;">${esc(reason)}</td>
            <td class="right mono">${fmtMoney(a.totalAmount)}</td>
            <td class="right mono">${a.lastBuyDate ? fmtShortDate(a.lastBuyDate) : '-'}</td>
            <td class="right mono">${a.attempts}<div style="font-size:10px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;">S ${a.salePitchAttempts||0} / F ${a.followupAttempts||0}</div></td>
            <td>${a.lastOutcome ? `<span class="badge b-slate">${esc(a.lastOutcome)}</span>` : '-'}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="8" style="padding:14px;color:#64748b;">ยังไม่มีกลุ่มลูกค้าตามเงื่อนไขนี้</td></tr>`;
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.(aliceTbody);
    }
    function renderAliceAnalysis(){
      renderAliceKpis();
      renderAliceCampaignCards();
      renderAliceSelected();
    }
    function exportAliceSelectedCSV(){
      const campaign = ALICE_CAMPAIGNS.find(c=>c.id===aliceSelectedCampaign) || ALICE_CAMPAIGNS[0];
      const rows = aliceCurrentRows || [];
      const header = ['opd','name','phone','campaign','action','reason','total_amount','last_buy_date','attempts','last_outcome','segment','priority'];
      const csvRows = [header, ...rows.map(a=>[
        a.opd, a.name, a.phone, campaign.name, aliceActionFor(a,campaign.id), aliceReasonFor(a,campaign.id), a.totalAmount, a.lastBuyDate, a.attempts, a.lastOutcome, a.segment, a.priority
      ])];
      const csv = csvRows.map(r=> r.map(v=> `"${String(v??'').replaceAll('\"','\"\"')}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'}));
      a.download = `alice_campaign_${campaign.id}_${todayISO()}.csv`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
      showToast('Export วิเคราะห์จากอริส แล้ว');
    }

    function renderCustomersTable(){
      let list = [...analytics];

      const q = (custQ.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
      const seg = custSegment.value || '';
      const sort = custSort.value || 'last_pitch_desc';
      const limit = parseInt(custLimit.value||'50', 10);

      if(seg) list = list.filter(a=> a.segment === seg);

      if(q){
        list = list.filter(a=>
          String(a.opd).toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          String(a.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          String(a.phone||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }

      if(sort==='priority_desc') list.sort((a,b)=> (b.priority-a.priority) || (b.totalAmount-a.totalAmount));
      if(sort==='value_desc') list.sort((a,b)=> (b.totalAmount-a.totalAmount) || (b.priority-a.priority));
      if(sort==='last_pitch_desc') list.sort((a,b)=> String(b.lastPitchDate||'').localeCompare(a.lastPitchDate||''));
      if(sort==='attempts_desc') list.sort((a,b)=> (b.attempts-a.attempts) || (b.priority-a.priority));

      const shown = list.slice(0, limit);

      custTbody.innerHTML = shown.map((a,i)=>`
        <tr>
          <td class="mono">${i+1}</td>
          <td>
            <a class="link customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(a.opd)}" data-open-profile="${esc(a.opd)}">${esc(a.name)}</a>
            <div class="compact-muted">OPD <span class="mono">${esc(a.opd)}</span>${a.phone?` • ${esc(a.phone)}`:''} • ${customerOPDStatusBadge(a.opd)}</div>
          </td>
          <td><div class="compact-status-line">${segBadge(a.segment)} ${customerOPDStatusBadge(a.opd)} ${valueBadge(a)}</div></td>
          <td style="min-width:190px;color:#334155;font-weight:800;">${esc(a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || '-')}</td>
          <td class="right mono"><strong>${a.priority}</strong></td>
          <td class="right mono">${fmtMoney(a.totalAmount)}</td>
          <td class="right mono">${fmtMoney(a.avgAmount)}</td>
          <td class="right mono">${a.lastBuyDate ? fmtShortDate(a.lastBuyDate) : '-'}</td>
          <td class="right mono">${a.lastPitchDate ? fmtShortDate(a.lastPitchDate) : '-'}</td>
          <td>${a.lastOutcome ? `<span class="badge b-slate">${esc(a.lastOutcome)}</span>` : '-'}</td>
          <td class="right mono">${a.attempts}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="11" style="padding:14px; color:#64748b;">ไม่พบลูกค้าตามเงื่อนไข</td></tr>`;
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.(custTbody);
    }

    function renderHistorySummary(){
      const from = (histFrom.value||'').trim();
      const to = (histTo.value||'').trim();
      histSummaryRange.textContent = (from||to) ? `${from||'—'} ถึง ${to||'—'}` : 'ทั้งหมด';

      const calls = historyAll.length;
      const interested = historyAll.filter(p=> isInterested(p.outcome)).length;

      const uniq = new Set(historyAll.map(p=> pad4(p.opd||''))).size;

      histSummaryCalls.textContent = String(calls);
      histSummaryInterested.textContent = String(interested);
      histSummaryUnique.textContent = String(uniq);

      const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(calls / HIST_PAGE_SIZE));
      histPage = Math.min(histPage, totalPages);
      histPageNow.textContent = String(histPage);
      histPageTotal.textContent = String(totalPages);

      btnHistPrev.disabled = histPage <= 1;
      btnHistNext.disabled = histPage >= totalPages;
    }

    function renderHistoryTablePaged(){
      renderHistorySummary();
      const start = (histPage - 1) * HIST_PAGE_SIZE;
      const pageItems = historyAll.slice(start, start + HIST_PAGE_SIZE);
      renderHistoryTable(pageItems);
    }

    function renderHistoryTable(list){
      histTbody.innerHTML = list.map(p=>{
        const d = String(p.created_at||p.date||'').slice(0,10);
        const t = String(p.created_at||'').slice(11,16) || '-';
        const opd = pad4(p.opd||'');
        const name = p.customer_name || customerByOPD.get(opd)?.name || opd;
        const promo = p.promotion || '';
        const outcome = p.outcome || '';
        const content = p.content || '';
        const channel = p.channel || '';
        const id = p.id || `${p.created_at||''}|${opd}`;

        return `
          <tr data-rowid="${esc(id)}">
            <td class="mono">${fmtShortDate(d)}</td>
            <td class="mono">${esc(t)}</td>
            <td>
              <a class="link customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(opd)}" data-open-profile="${esc(opd)}">${esc(name)}</a>
              <div class="compact-muted">OPD <span class="mono">${esc(opd)}</span> • ${customerOPDStatusBadge(opd)}</div>
            </td>
            <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(callTypeLabel(p))}</span></td>
            <td>${esc(promo)}</td>
            <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(outcome)}</span></td>
            <td>${esc(content)}</td>
            <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(channel||'-')}</span></td>
            <td class="right">
              <button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" data-edit="${esc(id)}" title="แก้ไข">✏️</button>
              <button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" data-del="${esc(id)}" title="ลบ">🗑️</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="9" style="padding:14px; color:#64748b;">ยังไม่มีข้อมูล</td></tr>`;
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.(histTbody);
    }

    // ===================== ✅ Today Summary (added) =====================
    function kpiBox(label, value, hint=''){
      return `
        <div class="kpi">
          <div class="label">${esc(label)}</div>
          <div class="value mono">${esc(value)}</div>
          <div class="hint">${esc(hint)}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderFreqBadges(mapObj, limit=8){
      const arr = Array.from(mapObj.entries()).sort((a,b)=> b[1]-a[1]).slice(0, limit);
      if(!arr.length) return `<span style="color:#64748b;">-</span>`;
      return arr.map(([k,v])=> `<span class="badge b-slate">${esc(k)} <span class="mono">${v}</span></span>`).join(' ');
    }

    function setTodaySummaryExpanded(expanded){
      todaySummaryExpanded = !!expanded;
      if(todaySummaryCard) todaySummaryCard.classList.toggle('expanded', todaySummaryExpanded);
      if(btnToggleTodaySummary) btnToggleTodaySummary.textContent = todaySummaryExpanded ? 'หุบ' : 'เปิดดู';
      if(todaySummaryMini && !todaySummaryMini.dataset.loaded){
        todaySummaryMini.textContent = todaySummaryExpanded ? 'กำลังแสดงรายละเอียด' : 'หุบอยู่ • กดเปิดเมื่อต้องการดูรายละเอียด';
      }
    }

    async function loadTodaySummary(){
      const d = planDate.value || todayISO();
      todaySummaryDate.textContent = fmtShortDate(d);

      try{
        const url = new URL('/api/pitches_by_date', window.location.origin);
        url.searchParams.set('from', d);
        url.searchParams.set('to', d);

        const list = await fetchJSON(url).catch(()=>[]);
        const rows = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
        rows.sort((a,b)=> String(b.created_at||b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.created_at||a.date||'')));

        const total = rows.length;
        const interested = rows.filter(r=> isInterested(r.outcome)).length;
        const hardReject = rows.filter(r=> isHardReject(r.outcome)).length;

        const noPickup = rows.filter(r=> {
          const o = String(r.outcome||'');
          return o.includes('ไม่รับสาย') || o.includes('ปิดเครื่อง');
        }).length;

        const uniq = new Set(rows.map(r=> pad4(r.opd||''))).size;
        if(todaySummaryMini){
          todaySummaryMini.dataset.loaded = '1';
          todaySummaryMini.innerHTML = `วันนี้โทร <strong class="mono">${total}</strong> รายการ • สนใจ <strong class="mono">${interested}</strong> • ลูกค้า <strong class="mono">${uniq}</strong> คน`;
        }

        const freqOutcome = new Map();
        const freqChannel = new Map();
        const freqPromo = new Map();

        for(const r of rows){
          const o = String(r.outcome||'(ไม่ระบุ)').trim() || '(ไม่ระบุ)';
          const ch = String(r.channel||'(ไม่ระบุ)').trim() || '(ไม่ระบุ)';
          const pr = String(r.promotion||'(ไม่ระบุ)').trim() || '(ไม่ระบุ)';
          freqOutcome.set(o, (freqOutcome.get(o)||0) + 1);
          freqChannel.set(ch, (freqChannel.get(ch)||0) + 1);
          freqPromo.set(pr, (freqPromo.get(pr)||0) + 1);
        }

        const topOutcome = Array.from(freqOutcome.entries()).sort((a,b)=> b[1]-a[1])[0]?.[0] || '-';
        const topChannel = Array.from(freqChannel.entries()).sort((a,b)=> b[1]-a[1])[0]?.[0] || '-';

        todayKpis.innerHTML =
          kpiBox('โทรทั้งหมด (วันนี้)', total, '') +
          kpiBox('สนใจ', interested, '') +
          kpiBox('ปฏิเสธ/ควรหยุด', hardReject, '') +
          kpiBox('ไม่รับสาย/ปิดเครื่อง', noPickup, '');

        todaySummaryTbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r=>{
          const t = String(r.created_at||'').slice(11,16) || '-';
          const opd = pad4(r.opd||'');
          const name = r.customer_name || customerByOPD.get(opd)?.name || opd;
          const promo = r.promotion || '';
          const outcome = r.outcome || '';
          const content = r.content || '';
          return `
            <tr>
              <td class="mono">${esc(t)}</td>
              <td>
                <a class="link customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(opd)}" data-open-profile="${esc(opd)}">${esc(name)}</a>
                <div class="compact-muted">OPD <span class="mono">${esc(opd)}</span> • ${customerOPDStatusBadge(opd)}</div>
              </td>
              <td>${esc(promo)}</td>
              <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(outcome)}</span></td>
              <td>${esc(content)}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="5" style="padding:14px; color:#64748b;">วันนี้ยังไม่มีข้อมูลที่บันทึก</td></tr>`;
        window.applyCustomerNameColors?.(todaySummaryTbody);

        todayStats.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:1000; margin-bottom:8px;">สรุป Outcome</div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">${renderFreqBadges(freqOutcome, 8)}</div>`;
        todayPromoTop.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:1000; margin-bottom:8px;">โปรโมชันที่บันทึกวันนี้</div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">${renderFreqBadges(freqPromo, 8)}</div>`;

      }catch(e){
        console.error(e);
        todayKpis.innerHTML = '';
        todayStats.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ef4444;">โหลดสรุปวันนี้ไม่สำเร็จ</span>`;
        todayPromoTop.innerHTML = '';
        todaySummaryTbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" style="padding:14px; color:#64748b;">-</td></tr>`;
        if(todaySummaryMini){
          todaySummaryMini.dataset.loaded = '1';
          todaySummaryMini.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ef4444;">โหลดสรุปวันนี้ไม่สำเร็จ</span>`;
        }
        showToast('โหลดสรุปวันนี้ไม่สำเร็จ','error');
      }
    }
    // ===================== /Today Summary =====================


    // ===================== Follow up =====================
    function followupItemNameOnly(raw){
      let s = String(raw || '').trim();
      if(!s) return '';
      s = s.replace(/^[•\-\s]+/, '').trim();

      // ตัดคำบอกหมวดออก ให้หน้า Follow up เห็นสินค้า/บริการจริงทันที
      s = s.replace(/^(หมวดบริการ|หมวดสินค้า|หมวด|ประเภท|category|group)\s*[:：]\s*/i, '').trim();

      // รูปแบบที่มักเจอ: "Filler: Restylane", "Botox / Allergan", "Skin > Exosome"
      const knownCats = /^(botox|โบท็อกซ์|filler|ฟิลเลอร์|skin|ผิว|หน้า|hifu|fat|ไขมัน|drip|วิตามิน|ปากกา|ลดน้ำหนัก|ร้อยไหม|thread|laser|เลเซอร์|treatment|ทรีตเมนต์|other|อื่นๆ)$/i;
      const stripBySeparator = (sepRe)=>{
        const parts = s.split(sepRe).map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        if(parts.length >= 2 && knownCats.test(parts[0])){
          s = parts.slice(1).join(' ').trim();
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      };
      stripBySeparator(/\s*[\/|>→]\s*/);

      if(/[:：]/.test(s)){
        const parts = s.split(/[:：]/).map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const first = parts[0] || '';
        const rest = parts.slice(1).join(':').trim();
        if(rest && (knownCats.test(first) || (!/\d|บาท|cc|ml|ยูนิต|unit|ครั้ง|ชิ้น/i.test(first) && first.length <= 28))){
          s = rest;
        }
      }

      return s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
    function recordItemsText(r){
      const items = (r?.items || []).map(followupItemNameOnly).filter(Boolean);
      return items.slice(0, 8).map(x => `<span class="followup-item-name">${esc(x)}</span>`).join('') || '-';
    }
    function followupStatusForRecord(r){
      const score = Number(r?.followup_score || 0) || 0;
      if(r?.need_doctor_review) return 'doctor';
      if(score > 0 && score < 7) return 'low_score';
      if(r?.followup_at || r?.followup_status || r?.followup_result) return 'done';
      return 'pending';
    }
    function followupStatusBadge(r){
      const st = followupStatusForRecord(r);
      if(st === 'doctor') return '<span class="badge b-amber">ต้องให้หมอดู</span>';
      if(st === 'low_score') return '<span class="badge b-red">คะแนนต่ำ</span>';
      if(st === 'done') return '<span class="badge b-green">Follow up แล้ว</span>';
      return '<span class="badge b-slate">รอ Follow up</span>';
    }
    function isVipFollowupRecord(r){
      const opd = cleanOPDForRecord(r?.opd || '');
      return opd && getCustomerNameColor(opd) === 'gold';
    }
    const followupExpandedMonths = new Set();
    function baseFollowupRecords(){
      // แสดง VIP ด้วย แต่แถว VIP จะเป็น read-only เพราะหมอดูแลเอง
      return (records || []).filter(r => iso10(r.date) >= FOLLOWUP_START_DATE);
    }
    function followupDayKey(r){
      return iso10(r?.date || '') || 'ไม่ระบุวัน';
    }
    function followupDayLabel(dayKey){
      if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dayKey || '')) return 'ไม่ระบุวัน';
      return fmtShortDate(dayKey);
    }
    function followupMonthKey(r){
      const d = followupDayKey(r);
      return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d) ? d.slice(0,7) : 'ไม่ระบุเดือน';
    }
    function followupMonthLabel(monthKey){
      if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(monthKey || '')) return 'ไม่ระบุเดือน';
      const [y,m] = monthKey.split('-').map(Number);
      const names = ['มกราคม','กุมภาพันธ์','มีนาคม','เมษายน','พฤษภาคม','มิถุนายน','กรกฎาคม','สิงหาคม','กันยายน','ตุลาคม','พฤศจิกายน','ธันวาคม'];
      return `${names[(m || 1) - 1] || monthKey} ${y + 543}`;
    }
    function followupDisplayStatusBadges(r){
      const st = followupStatusForRecord(r);
      const parts = [];
      if(isVipFollowupRecord(r)) parts.push('<span class="badge b-gold">VIP</span>');
      if(st === 'pending') parts.push('<span class="badge b-red">ยังไม่ได้ Follow up</span>');
      else parts.push('<span class="badge b-green">Follow up แล้ว</span>');
      if(st === 'doctor') parts.push('<span class="badge b-amber">ต้องให้หมอดู</span>');
      else if(st === 'low_score') parts.push('<span class="badge b-red">คะแนนต่ำ</span>');
      return `<div class="followup-state-badges">${parts.join('')}</div>`;
    }
    function followupRecords(){
      const q = String(followupSearch?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const st = followupFilterStatus?.value || '';
      let rows = baseFollowupRecords();
      if(st) rows = rows.filter(r => followupStatusForRecord(r) === st || (st === 'done' && followupStatusForRecord(r) === 'low_score'));
      if(q){
        rows = rows.filter(r => `${r.opd||''} ${r.name||''} ${r.phone||''} ${(r.items||[]).join(' ')} ${r.followup_result||''} ${r.followup_note_short||''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      }
      rows.sort((a,b)=>{
        const ad = followupDayKey(a);
        const bd = followupDayKey(b);
        if(ad !== bd) return bd.localeCompare(ad);
        const ap = followupStatusForRecord(a) === 'pending' ? 0 : 1;
        const bp = followupStatusForRecord(b) === 'pending' ? 0 : 1;
        if(ap !== bp) return ap - bp;
        return String(a.name || a.opd || '').localeCompare(String(b.name || b.opd || ''), 'th');
      });
      return rows;
    }
    function renderFollowupKpis(){
      if(!followupKpis) return;
      const rows = baseFollowupRecords();
      const pending = rows.filter(r => followupStatusForRecord(r) === 'pending').length;
      const done = rows.filter(r => ['done','low_score','doctor'].includes(followupStatusForRecord(r))).length;
      const low = rows.filter(r => followupStatusForRecord(r) === 'low_score').length;
      const doctor = rows.filter(r => followupStatusForRecord(r) === 'doctor').length;
      const vip = rows.filter(isVipFollowupRecord).length;
      followupKpis.innerHTML =
        kpiBox('รอ Follow up', pending, 'รวม VIP') +
        kpiBox('Follow up แล้ว', done, 'รวม VIP') +
        kpiBox('VIP', vip, 'หมอดูแล') +
        kpiBox('คะแนนต่ำกว่า 7', low, '') +
        kpiBox('ต้องให้หมอดู', doctor, '');
    }
    function renderFollowupTable(){
      if(!followupTbody) return;
      renderFollowupKpis();
      const rows = followupRecords().slice(0, 300);

      const monthStats = new Map();
      const dayStats = new Map();
      for(const r of rows){
        const monthKey = followupMonthKey(r);
        const dayKey = followupDayKey(r);
        const st = followupStatusForRecord(r);
        const vip = isVipFollowupRecord(r);

        const ms = monthStats.get(monthKey) || { total:0, pending:0, done:0, vip:0 };
        ms.total += 1;
        if(st === 'pending') ms.pending += 1;
        else ms.done += 1;
        if(vip) ms.vip += 1;
        monthStats.set(monthKey, ms);

        const ds = dayStats.get(dayKey) || { total:0, pending:0 };
        ds.total += 1;
        if(st === 'pending') ds.pending += 1;
        dayStats.set(dayKey, ds);
      }

      const visibleMonths = [...new Set(rows.map(followupMonthKey))];
      if(visibleMonths.length && !visibleMonths.some(m => followupExpandedMonths.has(m))){
        followupExpandedMonths.add(visibleMonths[0]);
      }

      const html = [];
      let lastMonth = '';
      let lastDay = '';

      for(const r of rows){
        const monthKey = followupMonthKey(r);
        const dayKey = followupDayKey(r);
        const monthOpen = followupExpandedMonths.has(monthKey);

        if(monthKey !== lastMonth){
          lastMonth = monthKey;
          lastDay = '';
          const ms = monthStats.get(monthKey) || { total:0, pending:0, done:0, vip:0 };
          html.push(`
            <tr class="followup-month-row">
              <td colspan="9">
                <button type="button" class="followup-month-toggle" data-toggle-followup-month="${esc(monthKey)}" aria-expanded="${monthOpen ? 'true' : 'false'}">
                  <span class="followup-month-arrow">${monthOpen ? '▾' : '▸'}</span>
                  <span class="followup-month-title">${esc(followupMonthLabel(monthKey))}</span>
                  <span class="followup-month-stats">
                    <span class="followup-month-stat">${ms.total} รายการ</span>
                    <span class="followup-month-stat pending">🔴 รอ ${ms.pending}</span>
                    <span class="followup-month-stat done">🟢 เสร็จ ${ms.done}</span>
                    <span class="followup-month-stat vip">🟡 VIP ${ms.vip}</span>
                  </span>
                </button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          `);
        }

        if(dayKey !== lastDay){
          lastDay = dayKey;
          const ds = dayStats.get(dayKey) || { total:0, pending:0 };
          html.push(`<tr class="followup-day-row" data-followup-month="${esc(monthKey)}" ${monthOpen ? '' : 'hidden'}><td colspan="9">📅 วันที่ ${esc(followupDayLabel(dayKey))}<span class="day-count">${ds.total} รายการ</span><span class="day-pending">🔴 รอ ${ds.pending}</span></td></tr>`);
        }

        const id = String(r.id || r.sale_id || '');
        const opd = cleanOPDForRecord(r.opd || '');
        const score = r.followup_score || '';
        const isVip = isVipFollowupRecord(r);
        const rawResult = r.followup_result || r.followup_status || '';
        const result = rawResult || (isVip ? '' : FOLLOWUP_OUTCOMES[0]);
        const status = followupStatusForRecord(r);
        const saved = status !== 'pending';
        const locked = saved || isVip;
        const disabled = locked ? 'disabled' : '';
        const outcomeOptions = `${result ? '' : '<option value="">-</option>'}${FOLLOWUP_OUTCOMES.map(o=>`<option ${o===result?'selected':''}>${esc(o)}</option>`).join('')}`;

        html.push(`
          <tr class="followup-row ${saved ? 'saved' : ''} ${status === 'pending' ? 'is-pending' : 'is-complete'} ${status === 'doctor' ? 'doctor' : status === 'done' || status === 'low_score' ? 'done' : ''} ${isVip ? 'is-vip' : ''}" data-sale-id="${esc(id)}" data-opd="${esc(opd)}" data-vip="${isVip ? '1' : '0'}" data-followup-month="${esc(monthKey)}" ${monthOpen ? '' : 'hidden'}>
            <td>${followupDisplayStatusBadges(r)}</td>
            <td>
              <div class="followup-customer-cell">
                <a class="link customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(opd)}" data-open-profile="${esc(opd)}">${customerNameWithDiamond(r.name || customerByOPD.get(opd)?.name || opd, opd)}</a>
                ${customerOPDStatusBadge(opd)}
              </div>
            </td>
            <td><div class="followup-items">${recordItemsText(r)}</div></td>
            <td><select class="input" data-fu-outcome ${disabled}>${outcomeOptions}</select></td>
            <td><input class="input followup-score" data-fu-score type="number" min="1" max="10" step="1" value="${esc(score)}" ${disabled}></td>
            <td><input class="input followup-note-input" data-fu-note value="${esc(r.followup_note_short || '')}" placeholder="โน้ต" ${disabled}></td>
            <td style="text-align:center;"><input type="checkbox" data-fu-doctor ${r.need_doctor_review?'checked':''} ${disabled}></td>
            <td><input class="input" data-fu-next type="date" value="${esc(iso10(r.next_followup_at || ''))}" ${disabled}></td>
            <td class="right">
              <div class="followup-actions">
                ${isVip
                  ? '<span class="followup-vip-lock">VIP · หมอดูแล</span>'
                  : `<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-save-followup ${saved?'disabled':''}>บันทึก</button>${saved ? '<button class="btn" type="button" data-edit-followup>แก้ไข</button>' : ''}`
                }
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `);
      }

      followupTbody.innerHTML = html.join('') || `<tr><td colspan="9" style="padding:14px;color:#64748b;">ไม่มีรายการ</td></tr>`;
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.(followupTbody);
    }
    function enableFollowupRowEdit(tr){
      if(!tr || tr.dataset.vip === '1') return;
      tr.classList.add('editing');
      tr.querySelectorAll('[data-fu-outcome], [data-fu-score], [data-fu-note], [data-fu-doctor], [data-fu-next]').forEach(el=>{
        el.disabled = false;
      });
      const saveBtn = tr.querySelector('[data-save-followup]');
      if(saveBtn) saveBtn.disabled = false;
      const editBtn = tr.querySelector('[data-edit-followup]');
      if(editBtn){
        editBtn.disabled = true;
        editBtn.textContent = 'กำลังแก้ไข';
      }
      tr.querySelector('[data-fu-outcome], [data-fu-score], [data-fu-note]')?.focus();
    }
    async function saveFollowupRow(tr){
      if(tr?.dataset?.vip === '1'){
        showToast('VIP ให้หมอดูแลเอง','warn');
        return;
      }
      const saleId = tr?.dataset?.saleId || '';
      const opd = tr?.dataset?.opd || '';
      if(!saleId || !opd){ showToast('ไม่พบข้อมูลบิล/OPD','error'); return; }
      const payload = {
        sale_record_id: saleId,
        opd,
        promotion: 'Follow up หลังบริการ',
        outcome: tr.querySelector('[data-fu-outcome]')?.value || 'Follow up ปกติดี',
        followup_score: tr.querySelector('[data-fu-score]')?.value || null,
        content: tr.querySelector('[data-fu-note]')?.value || '',
        need_doctor_review: !!tr.querySelector('[data-fu-doctor]')?.checked,
        next_follow_up_at: tr.querySelector('[data-fu-next]')?.value || null,
        channel: 'call',
        call_type: 'followup'
      };
      if(!payload.content) payload.content = payload.outcome;
      try{
        const res = await fetch('/api/add_followup', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
        const d = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
        if(!res.ok) throw new Error(d.error || 'บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ');
        showToast('บันทึก Follow up แล้ว ✅');
        await reloadAllData(false);
        renderFollowupTable();
        await loadTodaySummary();
      }catch(e){
        showToast(String(e.message || 'บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ'), 'error');
      }
    }

    // ===================== History edit/delete =====================
    async function deletePitch(id){
      if(!confirm('ลบรายการนี้หรือไม่?')) return;
      try{
        const res = await fetch(`/api/delete_pitch?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method:'DELETE' });
        if(!res.ok) throw 0;
        showToast('ลบแล้ว ✅');
        await reloadAllData(false);
        await loadHistoryFromFilters();
        await loadTodaySummary(); // ✅ refresh summary
      }catch{
        showToast('ลบไม่สำเร็จ','error');
      }
    }

    async function editPitchInline(id){
      const p = pitches.find(x => String(x.id||`${x.created_at||''}|${pad4(x.opd||'')}`) === String(id))
              || historyAll.find(x => String(x.id||`${x.created_at||''}|${pad4(x.opd||'')}`) === String(id));
      if(!p){ showToast('ไม่พบรายการนี้','warn'); return; }

      const promotion = prompt('โปรโมชัน', p.promotion||'') ?? null;
      if(promotion===null) return;
      const outcome = prompt('Outcome', p.outcome||'') ?? null;
      if(outcome===null) return;
      const content = prompt('คอมเมนต์', p.content||'') ?? null;
      if(content===null) return;
      const channel = prompt('ช่องทาง (call/line/visit/facebook/instagram/other)', p.channel||'call') ?? null;
      if(channel===null) return;

      try{
        const res = await fetch('/api/update_pitch', {
          method:'PUT',
          headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
          body: JSON.stringify({ id, promotion, outcome, content, channel })
        });
        if(!res.ok) throw 0;
        showToast('บันทึกการแก้ไขแล้ว ✅');
        await reloadAllData(false);
        await loadHistoryFromFilters();
        await loadTodaySummary(); // ✅ refresh summary
      }catch{
        showToast('แก้ไขไม่สำเร็จ','error');
      }
    }


    function forcePlanToday(){
      const t = todayISO();
      setPlanDateValue(t);
      return t;
    }

    function getDuplicateOPDs(){
      const counts = new Map();
      $$('#planRows .plan-row').forEach(rowEl=>{
        const opd = rowEl.dataset.opd || '';
        if(!opd) return;
        counts.set(opd, (counts.get(opd)||0)+1);
      });
      return new Set(Array.from(counts.entries()).filter(([_,n])=>n>1).map(([opd])=>opd));
    }

    function updateDuplicateMarks(){
      const dup = getDuplicateOPDs();
      $$('#planRows .plan-row').forEach(rowEl=>{
        const opd = rowEl.dataset.opd || '';
        const isDup = !!opd && dup.has(opd);
        rowEl.classList.toggle('dup', isDup);
        const meta = rowEl.querySelector('[data-meta]');
        if(meta && isDup){
          const base = meta.dataset.base || meta.textContent || '';
          meta.dataset.base = base.replace(' • ซ้ำในรายการ','');
          meta.textContent = meta.dataset.base + ' • ซ้ำในรายการ';
        }else if(meta && meta.dataset.base){
