          meta.textContent = meta.dataset.base;
        }
      });
      return dup;
    }

    function planContactStatusClass(status){
      if(status === 'CALL') return 'call';
      if(status === 'LATER') return 'later';
      if(status === 'PAUSE') return 'pause';
      if(status === 'STOP') return 'stop';
      return '';
    }

    function planContactStatusIcon(status){
      if(status === 'CALL') return '✅';
      if(status === 'LATER') return '⏳';
      if(status === 'PAUSE') return '⚠️';
      if(status === 'STOP') return '🛑';
      return 'ℹ️';
    }

    function getPlanContactInsight(opd){
      const key = pad4(opd || '');
      if(!key) return null;
      const a = analytics.find(x => x.opd === key) || calcCustomerAnalytics(key);
      const status = a.contactStatus || a.segment || 'CALL';
      const label = CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS[status] || status || 'ตรวจสอบ';
      const reason = a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || a.recommend || 'ไม่มีเหตุผลเพิ่มเติม';
      return { status, label, reason, nameColor: a.nameColor || getCustomerNameColor(key), isHighValue: !!a.isHighValue, priority: a.priority || 0, lastBuyDate: a.lastBuyDate || '', lastPitchDate: a.lastPitchDate || '' };
    }

    function updatePlanRowContactNote(rowEl){
      if(!rowEl) return;
      const note = rowEl.querySelector('[data-contact-note]');
      if(!note) return;
      const opd = rowEl.dataset.opd || '';
      if(!opd){
        note.className = 'contact-note';
        note.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }
      const info = getPlanContactInsight(opd);
      if(!info){
        note.className = 'contact-note';
        note.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }
      const cls = planContactStatusClass(info.status);
      const icon = planContactStatusIcon(info.status);
      const extra = [];
      if(info.isHighValue) extra.push('VIP/มูลค่าสูง');
      if(info.lastBuyDate) extra.push(`มาล่าสุด ${fmtShortDate(info.lastBuyDate)}`);
      if(info.lastPitchDate) extra.push(`โทรล่าสุด ${fmtShortDate(info.lastPitchDate)}`);
      note.className = `contact-note show ${cls}`;
      note.innerHTML = `
        <span class="note-title">${icon} ${esc(info.label)}</span>
        <span class="note-piece">• OPD ${customerOPDStatusBadge(opd, {short:true})}</span>
        <span class="note-piece">• ${esc(info.reason)}</span>
        ${extra.length ? `<span class="note-piece">• ${extra.map(esc).join(' • ')}</span>` : ''}
      `;
    }

    function updateAllPlanContactNotes(){
      $$('#planRows .plan-row').forEach(updatePlanRowContactNote);
    }

    function showBatchSaveSummary(savedRows){
      if(!lastSaveSummary) return;
      const rows = savedRows || [];
      const freq = new Map();
      for(const r of rows){
        const k = String(r.outcome||'(ไม่ระบุ)').trim() || '(ไม่ระบุ)';
        freq.set(k, (freq.get(k)||0)+1);
      }
      const chips = Array.from(freq.entries())
        .sort((a,b)=> b[1]-a[1])
        .map(([k,v])=> `<span class="badge b-slate">${esc(k)} <span class="mono">${v}</span></span>`)
        .join(' ');
      lastSaveSummary.classList.add('show');
      lastSaveSummary.innerHTML = `
        <div style="font-weight:1000; margin-bottom:8px; color:#065f46;">✅ บันทึกสำเร็จ ${rows.length} รายการ</div>
        <div class="summary-line">${chips || '<span class="badge b-slate">ไม่มีข้อมูล</span>'}</div>
      `;
    }


    // ===================== Party Focus helpers =====================
    async function apiParty(url, options={}){
      const res = await fetch(url, options);
      const data = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
      return data;
    }

    async function refreshPartyFocus(){
      try{
        const data = await apiParty('/api/party_focus');
        partyGroups = data.groups || [];
        renderPartySelects();
      }catch(e){ console.warn(e); }
    }

    function renderPartySelects(){
      if(!planPartySelect) return;
      const current = planPartySelect.value || '';
      planPartySelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">เลือกปาตี้ที่สร้างไว้</option>' +
        partyGroups.map(g=>`<option value="${esc(g.id)}">${esc(g.name)} (${Number(g.member_count||0).toLocaleString()} คน)</option>`).join('');
      if(current) planPartySelect.value = current;
    }

    async function fetchProfileImage(opd){
      const opd4 = pad4(opd);
      const masterUrl = customerByOPD.get(opd4)?.profile_pic_url || '';
      if(masterUrl) return masterUrl;
      try{
        const res = await fetch(`/api/get_gallery?opd=${encodeURIComponent(opd4)}`);
        if(!res.ok) return '';
        const rows = await res.json();
        const arr = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : (rows.images || rows.data || []);
        const profile = arr.find(x=>x.is_profile || x.image_type==='profile') || arr[0];
        return profile?.image_url || profile?.url || '';
      }catch{return '';}
    }

    async function renderCustomerPartyTab(opd){
      const box = $('#modalPartyMembershipBox');
      if(!box) return;
      const a = analytics.find(x=> x.opd === opd) || calcCustomerAnalytics(opd);
      box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#64748b;font-weight:800;">กำลังโหลดปาตี้...</div>';
      try{
        const data = await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/customer/${encodeURIComponent(pad4(opd))}`);
        const groups = data.groups || [];
        box.innerHTML = groups.map(g=>`
          <div class="party-membership-item" data-party-id="${esc(g.id)}" data-opd="${esc(opd)}">
            <div class="party-membership-head">
              <label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#0f172a;">
                <input type="checkbox" data-party-toggle ${g.is_member?'checked':''}> ${esc(g.name)}
              </label>
              <span class="badge ${g.is_member?'b-green':'b-slate'}">${g.is_member?'อยู่ในปาตี้':'ยังไม่อยู่'}</span>
            </div>
            <input class="party-note-input" data-party-note value="${esc(g.member_note || '')}" placeholder="หมายเหตุเฉพาะลูกค้าคนนี้ในปาตี้นี้" ${g.is_member?'':'disabled'}>
            <div style="color:#64748b;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.45;">${esc(g.note || '')}</div>
          </div>
        `).join('') || '<div style="color:#64748b;font-weight:800;">ยังไม่มีปาตี้ให้เลือก</div>';
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-party-toggle]').forEach(chk=>{
          chk.addEventListener('change', async ()=>{
            const row = chk.closest('.party-membership-item');
            const noteInput = row.querySelector('[data-party-note]');
            await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/customer/${encodeURIComponent(pad4(opd))}`, {
              method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
              body:JSON.stringify({
                party_id:row.dataset.partyId,
                action:chk.checked?'add':'remove',
                customer_name:a.name,
                phone:a.phone,
                note:noteInput?.value || ''
              })
            });
            await refreshPartyFocus();
            await renderCustomerPartyTab(opd);
            showToast(chk.checked ? 'เพิ่มเข้าปาตี้แล้ว' : 'ลบออกจากปาตี้แล้ว');
          });
        });
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-party-note]').forEach(inp=>{
          inp.addEventListener('change', async ()=>{
            if(inp.disabled) return;
            const row = inp.closest('.party-membership-item');
            await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(row.dataset.partyId)}/members/${encodeURIComponent(pad4(opd))}`, {
              method:'PUT', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({note:inp.value || ''})
            });
            showToast('บันทึกหมายเหตุปาตี้แล้ว');
          });
        });
      }catch(e){
        box.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#991b1b;font-weight:800;">โหลดปาตี้ไม่สำเร็จ: ${esc(e.message)}</div>`;
      }
    }

    async function loadPartyToPlan(){
      const partyId = planPartySelect?.value || '';
      if(!partyId){ showToast('เลือกปาตี้ก่อน','warn'); return; }
      const data = await apiParty(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(partyId)}/members`);
      const members = data.members || [];
      if(!members.length){ showToast('ปาตี้นี้ยังไม่มีลูกค้า','warn'); return; }
      planRows.innerHTML = '';
      for(const m of members){
        const c = customerByOPD.get(pad4(m.opd)) || {opd:m.opd, name:m.customer_name||'', phone:m.phone||''};
        const label = `${c.name || m.customer_name || '-'} — ${pad4(c.opd || m.opd)}${(c.phone||m.phone)?` / ${c.phone||m.phone}`:''}`;
        addPlanRow({opd:pad4(c.opd||m.opd), customer_label:label, outcome:OUTCOMES[0], content:m.note || ''});
      }
      refreshPlanCounters();
      saveDraft();
      showToast(`โหลดปาตี้ ${members.length} คนเข้ารายการโทรแล้ว`);
    }

    // ===================== Plan UI =====================
    function initPlanDefaults(){
      forcePlanToday();
      if(planDefaultChannel){
        planDefaultChannel.innerHTML = '<option value="call" selected>call</option>';
        planDefaultChannel.value = 'call';
      }
    }

    function createPlanRow(row = {}){
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'plan-row';
      el.dataset.opd = row.opd || '';

      el.innerHTML = `
        <div>
          <div class="field">
            <label>ลูกค้า (พิมพ์ชื่อ / OPD / เบอร์)</label>
            <input class="input" data-cust list="customerList" placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อ / OPD / เบอร์" value="${esc(row.customer_label||'')}">
            <div class="meta" data-meta>—</div>
            <div class="contact-note" data-contact-note></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <div class="field">
            <label>Outcome</label>
            <select class="input" data-outcome>
              ${OUTCOMES.map(o=> `<option ${o===(row.outcome||OUTCOMES[0])?'selected':''}>${esc(o)}</option>`).join('')}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <div class="field">
            <label>หมายเหตุ</label>
            <input class="input" data-note placeholder="เช่น นัดวัน / ขอคิดก่อน / โทรไม่ติด" value="${esc(row.content||'')}">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="row-actions">
          <button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" data-open-profile title="ดูโปรไฟล์">📇</button>
          <button class="btn" type="button" data-add-next title="เพิ่มลูกค้าต่อ">➕ ต่อ</button>
          <button class="btn btn-icon btn-danger" type="button" data-del-row title="ลบแถว">🗑️</button>
        </div>
      `;

      const meta = el.querySelector('[data-meta]');
      if(row.opd){
        const c = customerByOPD.get(pad4(row.opd));
        const text = c ? `OPD ${pad4(c.opd)}${c.phone?` • ${c.phone}`:''} • สถานะ ${nameColorInfo(c.name_color).label}` : `OPD ${pad4(row.opd)} • สถานะ ${nameColorInfo(getCustomerNameColor(row.opd)).label}`;
        meta.textContent = text;
        meta.dataset.base = text;
      }
      updatePlanRowContactNote(el);
      return el;
    }

    function refreshPlanCounters(){
      const rows = getPlanRowsPayload(true);
      const dup = updateDuplicateMarks();
      updateAllPlanContactNotes();
      const valid = rows.filter(x=> x.opd && x.outcome && !dup.has(x.opd)).length;
      const invalid = Math.max(0, rows.length - valid);
      planCount.textContent = rows.length.toString();
      planValid.textContent = valid.toString();
      if(planInvalid) planInvalid.textContent = invalid.toString();
      const saveBtn = btnSaveBulk2;
      if(saveBtn) saveBtn.disabled = rows.length === 0 || valid === 0 || invalid > 0;
    }

    function getPlanRowsPayload(includeInvalid=false){
      const date = forcePlanToday();
      const rows = [];
      const centralPromo = (planDefaultPromo.value || '').trim();
      $$('#planRows .plan-row').forEach(rowEl=>{
        const opd = rowEl.dataset.opd || '';
        const customer_label = rowEl.querySelector('[data-cust]')?.value?.trim() || '';
        const outcome = rowEl.querySelector('[data-outcome]')?.value || '';
        const content = rowEl.querySelector('[data-note]')?.value?.trim() || '';
        const valid = !!opd && !!outcome;
        if(valid || includeInvalid){
          rows.push({ date, opd, promotion: centralPromo, outcome, content, channel:'call', call_type:'sale_pitch', customer_label });
        }
      });
      return rows;
    }

    function addPlanRow(row={}){
      const el = createPlanRow(row);
      planRows.appendChild(el);
      updatePlanRowContactNote(el);
      refreshPlanCounters();
      saveDraft();
      setTimeout(()=> el.querySelector('[data-cust]')?.focus(), 0);
    }

    function restorePlanDraft(){
      initPlanDefaults();
      const d = loadDraft();
      forcePlanToday();
      planDefaultPromo.value = d?.defaultPromo || planDefaultPromo.value || '';

      planRows.innerHTML = '';
      if(d?.rows?.length){
        for(const r of d.rows) addPlanRow(r);
      }else{
        addPlanRow({});
      }
      planDraftStatus.textContent = d ? 'restored' : '—';
      refreshPlanCounters();
    }

    async function saveBulkPitches(){
      forcePlanToday();
      const rows = getPlanRowsPayload(true);
      const dup = getDuplicateOPDs();

      if(dup.size){
        refreshPlanCounters();
        showToast('มีลูกค้าซ้ำในรายการ กรุณาลบหรือเปลี่ยนก่อนบันทึก','warn');
        return;
      }

      const invalid = rows.filter(r=> !r.opd);
      if(invalid.length){
        showToast('มีแถวที่ยังไม่ได้เลือกลูกค้า (OPD ว่าง)','warn');
        $$('#planRows .plan-row').forEach(rowEl=>{
          const custInput = rowEl.querySelector('[data-cust]');
          if(!rowEl.dataset.opd) custInput.classList.add('invalid');
          else custInput.classList.remove('invalid');
        });
        return;
      }

      const payload = rows
        .filter(r=> r.opd && r.outcome)
        .map(r=>({ date:r.date, opd:r.opd, promotion:r.promotion, outcome:r.outcome, content:r.content, channel:'call', call_type:'sale_pitch' }));

      if(!payload.length){
        showToast('ยังไม่มีรายการ valid ให้บันทึก','warn');
        return;
      }

      if(!confirm(`บันทึกทั้งหมด ${payload.length} รายการ ใช่ไหม?`)){
        showToast('ยกเลิกการบันทึก');
        return;
      }

      btnSaveBulk2.disabled = true;
      btnSaveBulk2.textContent = 'กำลังบันทึก...';

      try{
        const res = await fetch('/api/add_pitches_bulk', {
          method:'POST',
          headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        const d = await res.json().catch(()=> ({}));
        if(!res.ok) throw new Error(d.error||'บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ');

        showToast(`บันทึกสำเร็จ ${d.inserted||payload.length} รายการ ✅`);
        showBatchSaveSummary(payload);

        // ล้างเฉพาะรายชื่อลูกค้า แต่คงวันที่วันนี้และโปรโมชันเดิมไว้ เพื่อโทรชุดถัดไปต่อได้เร็ว
        planRows.innerHTML = '';
        addPlanRow({});
        localStorage.setItem(DRAFT_KEY, JSON.stringify({
          date: todayISO(),
          defaultPromo: planDefaultPromo.value || '',
          rows: []
        }));
        planDraftStatus.textContent = 'cleared rows';

        await reloadAllData(false);
        await loadTodaySummary();
      }catch(e){
        showToast(String(e.message||'บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ'), 'error');
      }finally{
        btnSaveBulk2.disabled = false;
        btnSaveBulk2.textContent = '💾 บันทึกทั้งหมด';
        refreshPlanCounters();
      }
    }

    // Plan event delegation
    planRows.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      refreshPlanCounters();
      saveDraft();
    });

    planRows.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
      const rowEl = e.target.closest('.plan-row');
      if(!rowEl) return;

      if(e.target.matches('[data-cust]')){
        const v = (e.target.value||'').trim();
        const picked = customerIndex.get(v);
        const meta = rowEl.querySelector('[data-meta]');
        if(picked){
          rowEl.dataset.opd = picked.opd;
          const text = `OPD ${picked.opd}${picked.phone?` • ${picked.phone}`:''} • สถานะ ${nameColorInfo(getCustomerNameColor(picked.opd)).label}`;
          meta.textContent = text;
          meta.dataset.base = text;
          e.target.classList.remove('invalid');
          updatePlanRowContactNote(rowEl);
        }else{
          rowEl.dataset.opd = '';
          meta.textContent = '—';
          meta.dataset.base = '—';
          e.target.classList.add('invalid');
          updatePlanRowContactNote(rowEl);
        }
        refreshPlanCounters();
        saveDraft();
      }
    });

    planRows.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const rowEl = e.target.closest('.plan-row');
      if(!rowEl) return;

      const del = e.target.closest('[data-del-row]');
      if(del){
        rowEl.remove();
        if(!$('#planRows .plan-row')) addPlanRow({});
        refreshPlanCounters();
        saveDraft();
        return;
      }

      const addNext = e.target.closest('[data-add-next]');
      if(addNext){
        addPlanRow({});
        return;
      }

      const open = e.target.closest('[data-open-profile]');
      if(open){
        const opd = rowEl.dataset.opd || '';
        if(!opd){ showToast('ยังไม่ได้เลือกลูกค้า','warn'); return; }
        openCustomerModal(opd);
        return;
      }
    });

    // ===================== History loader from filters (paged) =====================
    async function loadHistoryFromFilters(){
      const from = (histFrom.value||'').trim();
      const to = (histTo.value||'').trim();
      const q = (histQ.value||'').trim();
      const outcome = histOutcome.value || '';
      const channel = histChannel.value || '';

      try{
        const url = new URL('/api/pitches_by_date', window.location.origin);
        if(!from && !to){
          url.searchParams.set('from', '1970-01-01');
          url.searchParams.set('to', '9999-12-31');
        }else{
          if(from) url.searchParams.set('from', from);
          if(to) url.searchParams.set('to', to);
        }
        if(q) url.searchParams.set('q', q);
        if(outcome) url.searchParams.set('outcome', outcome);
        if(channel) url.searchParams.set('channel', channel);

        const list = await fetchJSON(url);
        historyAll = Array.isArray(list)?list:[];
        historyAll.sort((a,b)=> String(b.created_at||b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.created_at||a.date||'')));

        histPage = 1;
        renderHistoryTablePaged();

      }catch{
        historyAll = [];
        histPage = 1;
        renderHistoryTablePaged();
        showToast('โหลด ประวัติการโทร ไม่สำเร็จ','error');
      }
    }

    btnHistPrev.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      histPage = Math.max(1, histPage - 1);
      renderHistoryTablePaged();
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior:'smooth' });
    });
    btnHistNext.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(historyAll.length / HIST_PAGE_SIZE));
      histPage = Math.min(totalPages, histPage + 1);
      renderHistoryTablePaged();
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior:'smooth' });
    });

    // ===================== Export CSV =====================
    function exportCustomersCSV(list){
      const header = ['opd','name','phone','contact_status','reason','vip','priority','bucket','recommend','attempts','lastPitchDate','lastOutcome','totalAmount','paidVisits','avgAmount','lastBuyDate'];
      const lines = [header.join(',')];
      for(const a of list){
        const row = [
          a.opd, a.name, a.phone, CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS[a.segment] || a.segment, a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || '', a.isHighValue ? 'VIP' : '', a.priority, a.bucket, a.recommend,
          a.attempts, a.lastPitchDate, a.lastOutcome, Math.round(a.totalAmount),
          a.paidVisits, Math.round(a.avgAmount), a.lastBuyDate
        ].map(v=> `"${String(v??'').replaceAll('"','""')}"`);
        lines.push(row.join(','));
      }
      const csv = lines.join('\n');
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'}));
      a.download = `customers_${todayISO()}.csv`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
      showToast('Export ลูกค้า CSV แล้ว');
    }

    function exportHistoryCSVFromTable(){
      const rows = $$('#histTbody tr');
      if(!rows.length){ showToast('ไม่มีข้อมูลให้ export','warn'); return; }
      const header = ['date','time','opd','name','call_type','promotion','outcome','content','channel'];
      const lines = [header.join(',')];

      rows.forEach(tr=>{
        const tds = tr.querySelectorAll('td');
        if(tds.length < 8) return;
        const date = tds[0].innerText.trim();
        const time = tds[1].innerText.trim();
        const nameCell = tds[2].innerText.trim();
        const type = tds[3].innerText.trim();
        const promo = tds[4].innerText.trim();
        const outcome = tds[5].innerText.trim();
        const content = tds[6].innerText.trim();
        const channel = tds[7].innerText.trim();
        const m = nameCell.match(/OPD\s*(\d{4})/);
        const opd = m ? m[1] : '';
        const name = nameCell.split('\n')[0] || '';

        const row = [date,time,opd,name,type,promo,outcome,content,channel].map(v=> `"${String(v).replaceAll('"','""')}"`);
        lines.push(row.join(','));
      });

      const csv = lines.join('\n');
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'}));
      a.download = `history_${todayISO()}_page${histPage}.csv`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
      showToast('Export History (หน้านี้) CSV แล้ว');
    }

    // ===================== Modal (Customer Profile) =====================
    let lastFocusEl = null;
    let currentModalOPD = null;
    let currentModalTab = 'overview';

    function showCustomerModal(){
      lastFocusEl = document.activeElement;
      customerModal.style.display = 'flex';
      customerModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
      customerModalBox.focus();
    }
    function hideCustomerModal(){
      customerModal.style.display = 'none';
      customerModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      if(lastFocusEl && typeof lastFocusEl.focus === 'function') lastFocusEl.focus();
    }

    btnModalClose.addEventListener('click', hideCustomerModal);
    customerModal.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      if(e.target === customerModal) hideCustomerModal();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
      if(e.key === 'Escape') hideCustomerModal();
    });

    modalTabs.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const btn = e.target.closest('.modal-tab[data-tab]');
      if(!btn) return;
      currentModalTab = btn.dataset.tab;
      $$('#modalTabs .modal-tab').forEach(x=> x.classList.toggle('active', x===btn));
      renderCustomerModal(currentModalOPD);
    });

    async function saveModalAsImage(){
      if(typeof html2canvas === 'undefined'){
        alert('หน้านี้ยังไม่ได้โหลด html2canvas');
        return;
      }
      const canvas = await html2canvas(customerModalBox);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.download = `customer_${currentModalOPD||'unknown'}_${Date.now()}.png`;
      link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      link.click();
    }
    btnModalSaveImg.addEventListener('click', saveModalAsImage);

    async function openCustomerModal(opd){
      currentModalOPD = pad4(opd);
      currentModalTab = 'overview';
      $$('#modalTabs .modal-tab').forEach(x=> x.classList.toggle('active', x.dataset.tab==='overview'));
      await renderCustomerModal(currentModalOPD);
      showCustomerModal();
    }

    async function renderCustomerModal(opd){
      const a = analytics.find(x=> x.opd === opd) || calcCustomerAnalytics(opd);
      const pitchList = pitchesByOPD.get(opd) || [];
      const recList = getPurchaseRecordsForCustomer(opd);

      modalTitle.innerHTML = `📇 <span class="customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(a.opd)}">${esc(a.name)}</span> <span class="badge b-slate">OPD <span class="mono">${esc(a.opd)}</span></span>`;
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.(modalTitle);

      if(currentModalTab === 'overview'){
        const daysPitch = a.daysSincePitch===null ? '-' : `${a.daysSincePitch} วัน`;
        const daysBuy = a.daysSinceBuy===null ? '-' : `${a.daysSinceBuy} วัน`;
        const profileImg = await fetchProfileImage(opd);
        modalBody.innerHTML = `
          <div class="party-profile-layout">
            <div>${profileImg ? `<img class="party-profile-img" src="${esc(profileImg)}" alt="รูปโปรไฟล์ลูกค้า">` : `<div class="party-profile-img" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:900;">ไม่มีรูป</div>`}</div>
            <div class="mini-grid">
            <div class="mini">
              <div class="k">Priority</div>
              <div class="v mono">${a.priority}</div>
              <div class="s">${renderRecommend(a)}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="mini">
              <div class="k">สถานะติดต่อ</div>
              <div class="v">${segBadge(a.segment)}</div>
              <div class="s">${esc(a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || '-')}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="mini">
              <div class="k">ยอดซื้อรวม</div>
              <div class="v mono">${fmtMoney(a.totalAmount)} บาท</div>
              <div class="s">เฉลี่ย/ครั้ง ${fmtMoney(a.avgAmount)} • ${a.paidVisits} ครั้งจ่ายเงิน</div>
            </div>
            <div class="mini">
              <div class="k">ความล่าสุด</div>
              <div class="v mono">${a.lastPitchDate ? fmtShortDate(a.lastPitchDate) : '-'}</div>
              <div class="s">โทรล่าสุด: ${daysPitch} • มาล่าสุด: ${daysBuy}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style="height:12px;"></div>

          <div class="card" style="box-shadow:none;">
            <div class="card-head">
              <div class="card-title">🧾 สรุปสัญญาณ</div>
              <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                ${a.phone ? `<span class="badge b-slate">📞 ${esc(a.phone)}</span>` : `<span class="badge b-slate">📞 —</span>`}
                <span class="badge b-slate">โทรแล้ว <span class="mono">${a.attempts}</span> ครั้ง</span>
                <span class="badge b-slate">Sale <span class="mono">${a.salePitchAttempts || 0}</span></span>
                <span class="badge b-slate">Follow <span class="mono">${a.followupAttempts || 0}</span></span>
                ${a.everInterested ? `<span class="badge b-green">เคยสนใจ</span>` : `<span class="badge b-slate">ไม่เคยสนใจ</span>`}
                ${a.callBlockReason ? `<span class="badge b-slate">✅ ${esc(a.callBlockReason)}</span>` : ``}
                ${a.suppressTopPriority ? `<span class="badge b-slate">✅ ซื้อแล้วหลังโทร</span>` : ``}
                ${a.visitedRecently ? `<span class="badge b-slate">✅ มาแล้ว (ล่าสุด)</span>` : ``}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
              <div style="color:#334155; font-weight:900; margin-bottom:6px;">Outcome ล่าสุด</div>
              <div>${a.lastOutcome ? `<span class="badge b-slate">${esc(a.lastOutcome)}</span>` : `<span style="color:#64748b;">-</span>`}</div>

              <div style="height:10px;"></div>
              <div style="color:#334155; font-weight:900; margin-bottom:6px;">แนะนำ Next step</div>
              <div style="color:#0f172a;">
                ${a.segment==='CALL'
                  ? `ควรติดต่อลูกค้า: ${esc(a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || '')}`
                  : a.segment==='LATER'
                    ? `รอติดต่อภายหลัง: ${esc(a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || '')}`
                    : a.segment==='PAUSE'
                      ? `พักติดต่อก่อน เพื่อลดการเสียเวลา: ${esc(a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || '')}`
                      : `หยุดติดต่อ: ${esc(a.contactStatusReason || a.callReason || '')}`}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      if(currentModalTab === 'pitches'){
        const rows = pitchList.slice(0, 30).map(p=>{
          const d = String(p.created_at||p.date||'').slice(0,10);
          const promo = p.promotion || '-';
          const out = p.outcome || '-';
          const note = p.content || '';
          const ch = p.channel || '-';
          return `
            <tr>
              <td class="mono">${fmtShortDate(d)}</td>
              <td>${esc(promo)}</td>
              <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(out)}</span></td>
              <td>${esc(note)}</td>
              <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(ch)}</span></td>
            </tr>
          `;
        }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="5" style="padding:12px; color:#64748b;">ยังไม่มี Sale Pitch</td></tr>`;

        modalBody.innerHTML = `
          <div class="card" style="box-shadow:none;">
            <div class="card-head">
              <div class="card-title">🗣️ Sale Pitch ล่าสุด</div>
              <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                <span class="badge b-slate">แสดง 30 รายการล่าสุด</span>
                <button class="btn" type="button" id="btnCopyLastPromo">📋 คัดลอกโปรล่าสุด</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
              <div class="table-wrap">
                <table style="min-width:920px;">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>วันที่</th>
                      <th>โปรโมชัน</th>
                      <th>Outcome</th>
                      <th>โน้ต</th>
                      <th>ช่องทาง</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;

        setTimeout(()=>{
          const btn = $('#btnCopyLastPromo');
          if(!btn) return;
          btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
            const last = pitchList[0];
            if(!last || !last.promotion){ showToast('ไม่พบโปรโมชันล่าสุด','warn'); return; }
            planDefaultPromo.value = last.promotion;
            saveDraft();
            showToast('คัดลอกโปรโมชันไปที่ Plan แล้ว ✅');
          });
        }, 0);
        return;
      }


      if(currentModalTab === 'followup'){
        const rows = pitchList.filter(isFollowupLog).slice(0, 30).map(p=>{
          const d = String(p.created_at||p.date||'').slice(0,10);
          return `
            <tr>
              <td class="mono">${fmtShortDate(d)}</td>
              <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(p.outcome || '-')}</span></td>
              <td class="right mono">${p.followup_score || '-'}</td>
              <td>${p.need_doctor_review ? '<span class="badge b-amber">หมอดู</span>' : '-'}</td>
              <td>${esc(p.content || '')}</td>
              <td><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(p.channel || '-')}</span></td>
            </tr>
          `;
        }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:12px;color:#64748b;">ยังไม่มี Follow up</td></tr>`;
        modalBody.innerHTML = `
          <div class="card" style="box-shadow:none;">
            <div class="card-head"><div class="card-title">🩺 Follow up ล่าสุด</div></div>
            <div class="card-body">
              <div class="table-wrap">
                <table style="min-width:860px;">
                  <thead><tr><th>วันที่</th><th>ผล</th><th class="right">คะแนน</th><th>หมอดู</th><th>โน้ต</th><th>ช่องทาง</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      if(currentModalTab === 'party'){
        modalBody.innerHTML = `
          <div class="card" style="box-shadow:none;">
            <div class="card-head">
              <div>
                <div class="card-title">🎯 ปาตี้ของลูกค้าคนนี้</div>
              </div>
              <span class="badge b-slate">OPD <span class="mono">${esc(opd)}</span></span>
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
              <div id="modalPartyMembershipBox" class="party-membership-list"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        await renderCustomerPartyTab(opd);
        return;
      }

      // buys tab
      const paid = recList.filter(r=> Number(r.amount||0) > 0);
      const sum = paid.reduce((s,r)=> s + Number(r.amount||0), 0);

      const itemCounts = new Map();
      for(const r of recList){
        for(const item of (r.items||[])){
          let name = item;
          const m = item.match(/\((.*?)\)/);
          if(m) name = m[1];
          else name = item.split(' - ')[0];
          const qtyMatch = item.match(/- (\d+)\s*ชิ้น/);
          const qty = qtyMatch ? parseInt(qtyMatch[1],10) : 1;
          itemCounts.set(name, (itemCounts.get(name)||0) + qty);
        }
      }
      const topItems = Array.from(itemCounts.entries()).sort((a,b)=> b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,10);

      const historyHtml = recList.slice(0, 30).map(r=>{
        const d = iso10(r.date||'');
        const amount = Number(r.amount||0);
        const items = (r.items||[]).slice(0, 8).map(x=> `• ${esc(x)}`).join('<br>');
        const note = r.note ? `<div style="margin-top:6px; color:#334155; font-size:11px;"><b>หมายเหตุ:</b> ${esc(r.note)}</div>` : '';
        return `
          <div style="border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:10px 12px; background:#fff; margin-bottom:10px;">
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <div style="font-weight:1000;">📅 ${fmtShortDate(d)}</div>
              <div class="badge b-slate">💵 ${fmtMoney(amount)} บาท</div>
            </div>
            <div style="margin-top:8px; color:#475569; font-size:11px; line-height:1.55;">
              ${items || '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">(ไม่มีรายการสินค้า)</span>'}
            </div>
            ${note}
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('') || `<div style="padding:12px; color:#64748b;">ยังไม่มีประวัติซื้อ</div>`;

      modalBody.innerHTML = `
        <div class="mini-grid">
          <div class="mini">
            <div class="k">ยอดซื้อรวม</div>
            <div class="v mono">${fmtMoney(sum)} บาท</div>
            <div class="s">นับเฉพาะ amount &gt; 0</div>
          </div>
          <div class="mini">
            <div class="k">จำนวนบิล</div>
            <div class="v mono">${recList.length}</div>
            <div class="s">จ่ายเงินจริง ${paid.length}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="mini">
            <div class="k">ซื้อครั้งล่าสุด</div>
            <div class="v mono">${a.lastBuyDate ? fmtShortDate(a.lastBuyDate) : '-'}</div>
            <div class="s">ห่าง ${a.daysSinceBuy===null?'-':a.daysSinceBuy+' วัน'}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="mini">
            <div class="k">Top Items</div>
            <div class="v" style="font-size:12px; margin-top:10px;">
              ${topItems.length ? topItems.map(([n,q])=> `<div>${esc(n)} <span class="badge b-slate mono">${q}</span></div>`).join('') : '<span style="color:#64748b;">-</span>'}
            </div>
            <div class="s">10 อันดับแรก</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="height:12px;"></div>

        <div class="card" style="box-shadow:none;">
          <div class="card-head">
            <div class="card-title">🛍️ ประวัติซื้อย้อนหลัง</div>
          </div>
          <div class="card-body">
            ${historyHtml}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    // ===================== View switch (top tabs) =====================
    function showView(view){
      $$('[data-view-panel]').forEach(p=>{
        p.style.display = (p.dataset.viewPanel === view) ? '' : 'none';
      });
      $$('#topTabs .tab-btn').forEach(b=> b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.view === view));
      if(view === 'plan') restorePlanDraft();
      if(view === 'followup') renderFollowupTable();
      if(view === 'history') renderHistoryTablePaged();
      if(view === 'alice') renderAliceAnalysis();

      // ✅ เมื่อเข้าหน้า plan ให้โหลดสรุปวันนี้
      if(view === 'plan') loadTodaySummary();
    }

    topTabs.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const btn = e.target.closest('.tab-btn[data-view]');
      if(!btn) return;
      showView(btn.dataset.view);
    });

    btnRefreshFollowup?.addEventListener('click', ()=> renderFollowupTable());
    followupFilterStatus?.addEventListener('change', renderFollowupTable);
    followupSearch?.addEventListener('input', debounce(renderFollowupTable, 220));
    followupTbody?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const monthBtn = e.target.closest('[data-toggle-followup-month]');
      if(monthBtn){
        const monthKey = monthBtn.dataset.toggleFollowupMonth || '';
        const willOpen = !followupExpandedMonths.has(monthKey);
        if(willOpen) followupExpandedMonths.add(monthKey);
        else followupExpandedMonths.delete(monthKey);
        monthBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', willOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        const arrow = monthBtn.querySelector('.followup-month-arrow');
        if(arrow) arrow.textContent = willOpen ? '▾' : '▸';
        followupTbody.querySelectorAll(`tr[data-followup-month="${CSS.escape(monthKey)}"]`).forEach(row=>{
          row.hidden = !willOpen;
        });
        return;
      }
      const editBtn = e.target.closest('[data-edit-followup]');
      if(editBtn){
        enableFollowupRowEdit(editBtn.closest('tr'));
        return;
      }
      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-save-followup]');
      if(!btn || btn.disabled) return;
      saveFollowupRow(btn.closest('tr'));
    });

    // ===================== Main reload =====================
    async function reloadAllData(resetDashDates=true){
      lastSyncText.textContent = `Sync: กำลังโหลด...`;
      if(resetDashDates){
        dashFrom.value = '';
        dashTo.value = '';
      }

      // แต่ละชุดข้อมูลต้องไม่ลากทั้งหน้า CRM ให้ขาว ถ้า API เสริมตัวใดตัวหนึ่งมีปัญหา
      const [customerResult, salesResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
        fetchJSON('/api/customers'),
        loadSalesRecordsForCRM()
      ]);

      customers = customerResult.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(customerResult.value)
        ? customerResult.value : [];
      records = salesResult.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(salesResult.value)
        ? salesResult.value : [];

      if(customerResult.status === 'rejected') console.warn('[crm] customers load failed', customerResult.reason);
      if(salesResult.status === 'rejected') console.warn('[crm] sales load failed', salesResult.reason);

      try{
        await loadPitchesForDashboard();
      }catch(e){
        console.warn('[crm] pitches load failed', e);
        pitches = [];
      }

      try{
        await refreshPartyFocus();
      }catch(e){
        console.warn('[crm] party focus load failed', e);
      }

      try{
        buildCustomerIndexes();
        buildRecordsIndex();
        buildPitchesIndex();
        rebuildAnalytics();

        renderDashboard();
        renderAliceAnalysis();
        renderCustomersTable();
        renderFollowupTable();
        updateAllPlanContactNotes();

        const coreFailed = customerResult.status === 'rejected' || salesResult.status === 'rejected';
        lastSyncText.textContent = coreFailed ? `Sync: ข้อมูลบางส่วน` : `Sync: ${nowStamp()}`;
        if(coreFailed) showToast('โหลดข้อมูลบางส่วนไม่สำเร็จ แต่หน้าที่ยังใช้ได้ถูกแสดงแล้ว','warn');
      }catch(e){
        console.error('[crm] render failed', e);
        showToast('แสดงผลข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ','error');
        lastSyncText.textContent = `Sync: error`;
      }
    }

    async function loadPitchesForDashboard(){
      const from = (dashFrom.value||'').trim();
      const to = (dashTo.value||'').trim();
      const url = new URL('/api/pitches_by_date', window.location.origin);
      if(!from && !to){
        url.searchParams.set('from','1970-01-01');
        url.searchParams.set('to','9999-12-31');
      }else{
        if(from) url.searchParams.set('from', from);
        if(to) url.searchParams.set('to', to);
      }
      const list = await fetchJSON(url).catch(()=>[]);
      pitches = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    }


    aliceCampaignGrid?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const card = e.target.closest('[data-alice-campaign]');
      if(!card) return;
      aliceSelectedCampaign = card.dataset.aliceCampaign || 'call_ready';
      renderAliceAnalysis();
      const campaign = ALICE_CAMPAIGNS.find(c=>c.id===aliceSelectedCampaign);
      if(campaign) showToast(`วิเคราะห์: ${campaign.name} ✅`);
    });

    aliceSort?.addEventListener('change', renderAliceSelected);
    btnAliceReset?.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      aliceSelectedCampaign = 'call_ready';
      if(aliceSort) aliceSort.value = 'value_desc';
      renderAliceAnalysis();
      showToast('รีเซ็ต วิเคราะห์ แล้ว ✅');
    });
    btnAliceExport?.addEventListener('click', exportAliceSelectedCSV);

    segmentKpis?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const card = e.target.closest('[data-dash-segment]');
      if(!card) return;
      dashSegment.value = card.dataset.dashSegment || '';
      renderDashboard();
      showToast(`กรองสถานะ: ${segmentInfo(dashSegment.value).label} ✅`);
    });

    btnClearDashSegment?.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      dashSegment.value = '';
      renderDashboard();
      showToast('แสดงทุกสถานะแล้ว ✅');
    });

    // ===================== Dashboard filters =====================
    btnApplyDash.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      await loadPitchesForDashboard();
      buildPitchesIndex();
      rebuildAnalytics();
      renderDashboard();
      renderAliceAnalysis();
      renderCustomersTable();
      showToast('อัปเดต สรุปข้อมูล แล้ว ✅');
    });

    btnResetDash.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      dashFrom.value = ''; dashTo.value = '';
      dashSegment.value = ''; dashQ.value = '';
      await reloadAllData(false);
      renderAliceAnalysis();
      showToast('รีเซ็ต สรุปข้อมูล แล้ว');
    });

    // ===================== Customers filters =====================
    btnApplyCustomers.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      renderCustomersTable();
      showToast('อัปเดตตารางลูกค้าแล้ว ✅');
    });

    btnResetCustomers.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      custQ.value=''; custSegment.value=''; custSort.value='last_pitch_desc'; custLimit.value='50';
      renderCustomersTable();
      showToast('รีเซ็ตตารางลูกค้าแล้ว');
    });

    custQ.addEventListener('input', debounce(renderCustomersTable, 250));
    dashQ.addEventListener('input', debounce(()=>{ renderDashboard(); }, 250));

    // ===================== History controls =====================
    histOutcome.innerHTML = [`<option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>`, ...OUTCOMES.map(o=>`<option>${esc(o)}</option>`)].join('');
    histChannel.innerHTML = [`<option value="">ทั้งหมด</option>`, ...CHANNELS.map(c=> `<option value="${c}">${c}</option>`)].join('');

    btnLoadHistory.addEventListener('click', loadHistoryFromFilters);
    btnResetHistory.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      histFrom.value=''; histTo.value=''; histQ.value=''; histOutcome.value=''; histChannel.value='';
      loadHistoryFromFilters();
      showToast('รีเซ็ต ประวัติการโทร แล้ว');
    });

    histQ.addEventListener('input', debounce(loadHistoryFromFilters, 350));
    histOutcome.addEventListener('change', loadHistoryFromFilters);
    histChannel.addEventListener('change', loadHistoryFromFilters);
    histFrom.addEventListener('change', loadHistoryFromFilters);
    histTo.addEventListener('change', loadHistoryFromFilters);

    // History table actions
    histTbody.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const del = e.target.closest('[data-del]');
      if(del) return deletePitch(del.dataset.del);
      const ed = e.target.closest('[data-edit]');
      if(ed) return editPitchInline(ed.dataset.edit);
    });

    // ===================== Export buttons =====================
    btnExportCustomersCsv.addEventListener('click', ()=> exportCustomersCSV(filterAnalyticsForDash(analytics)));
    btnExportCustomersCsv2.addEventListener('click', ()=> exportCustomersCSV(analytics));
    btnExportHistoryCsv.addEventListener('click', exportHistoryCSVFromTable);

    // ===================== Plan controls =====================
    planDate.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      forcePlanToday();
      saveDraft();
      loadTodaySummary();
    });
    planDefaultPromo.addEventListener('input', saveDraft);

    btnAddRow.addEventListener('click', ()=> addPlanRow({}));
    btnAddRow2.addEventListener('click', ()=> addPlanRow({}));
    btnLoadPartyToPlan?.addEventListener('click', ()=> loadPartyToPlan().catch(e=>showToast('โหลดปาตี้ไม่สำเร็จ: '+e.message,'error')));
    btnSaveBulk2.addEventListener('click', saveBulkPitches);

    btnClearDraft.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if(!confirm('ล้าง Draft ทั้งหมด?')) return;
      clearDraft();
      planRows.innerHTML = '';
      addPlanRow({});
      forcePlanToday();
      if(lastSaveSummary) lastSaveSummary.classList.remove('show');
      planDraftStatus.textContent = 'cleared';
      showToast('ล้าง Draft แล้ว','warn');
    });

    // ✅ Manual reload today summary
    btnReloadTodaySummary.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      e.stopPropagation();
      loadTodaySummary();
    });
    btnToggleTodaySummary?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      e.stopPropagation();
      setTodaySummaryExpanded(!todaySummaryExpanded);
    });
    todaySummaryHeader?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      if(e.target.closest('button')) return;
      setTodaySummaryExpanded(!todaySummaryExpanded);
    });

    // ===================== Global click: open profile links =====================
    document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const a = e.target.closest('[data-open-profile]');
      if(a){
        const opd = a.getAttribute('data-open-profile');
        if(opd) openCustomerModal(opd);
      }
    });

    // ===================== Refresh all =====================
    btnRefreshAll.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      await reloadAllData(false);
      await loadTodaySummary(); // ✅ refresh summary
      showToast('รีเฟรชข้อมูลแล้ว ✅');
    });

    // ===================== Init =====================
    (async function init(){
      initPlanDefaults();

      setPlanDateValue(todayISO());

      custSort.value = 'last_pitch_desc';

      await reloadAllData(true);

      histFrom.value = '';
      histTo.value = '';
      await loadHistoryFromFilters();
      setTodaySummaryExpanded(false);

      const initialView = document.body?.dataset?.crmInitialView || 'plan';
      showView(initialView);
      if(initialView === 'plan') restorePlanDraft();

      await loadTodaySummary(); // ✅ initial load
    })();
  </script>

<template id="fcs-profile-template"><!-- Central Customer Profile Popup: shared by dashboard/customer_list/sale-summary/crm/tax/record pages -->
<div id="scp-modal" class="scp-modal" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="scp-backdrop" data-scp-close="1"></div>

  <div class="scp-image-panel">
    <button type="button" class="scp-image-close" id="scpImageCloseBtn">✕</button>

<script>/* Floating search UI. Uses the Dashboard engine and the existing customer profile popup. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const assetScript=document.currentScript;
  const profileCSS=assetScript?.dataset.profileCss;
  const profileJS=assetScript?.dataset.profileJs;
  function init(){
    if(document.getElementById('fcs-toggle') || !window.SumoCustomerSearch)return;
    const engine=window.SumoCustomerSearch;
    const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
    const glass='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.8"/><path d="m16 16 4.7 4.7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
    const host=document.createElement('div');host.id='fcs-root';
    host.innerHTML=`<button type="button" id="fcs-toggle" aria-label="ค้นหาลูกค้าด่วน" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="fcs-dialog">${glass}<span class="fcs-toggle-label">ค้นหาลูกค้า</span></button>
      <div id="fcs-overlay" hidden>
        <div class="fcs-backdrop" data-close></div>
        <section id="fcs-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="fcs-title" tabindex="-1">
          <header class="fcs-header"><span class="fcs-icon">${glass}</span><div><h2 id="fcs-title">ค้นหาลูกค้า</h2><p id="fcs-subtitle">ค้นชื่อ แล้วแตะเพื่อดูรายละเอียด</p></div><button type="button" class="fcs-close" data-close aria-label="ปิดค้นหาลูกค้า">×</button></header>
          <div class="fcs-body" id="fcs-body">
            <section id="fcs-quick"><label class="fcs-searchbox">${glass}<input id="fcs-name" type="search" autocomplete="off" placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อลูกค้า…" aria-label="ชื่อลูกค้าสำหรับค้นหาเร็ว"></label><div id="fcs-quick-results" class="fcs-results"></div></section>
            <form id="fcs-advanced" hidden>
              <div class="fcs-form-grid">
                <div class="fcs-field fcs-wide"><div class="fcs-field-heading"><span>สินค้าที่เคยซื้อ</span><button type="button" class="fcs-button fcs-small" id="fcs-add-product">＋ เพิ่มสินค้า</button></div><div id="fcs-products"></div></div>
                <div class="fcs-field"><span>ช่วงวันที่รับบริการ</span><div class="fcs-range"><input type="date" name="startDate" aria-label="วันที่เริ่มต้น"><span>ถึง</span><input type="date" name="endDate" aria-label="วันที่สิ้นสุด"></div></div>
                ${[['ยอดใช้จ่ายรวม','Total'],['จำนวนครั้งที่มาใช้บริการ','Visits'],['จำนวนวันที่ไม่ได้กลับมา','Absent'],['ยอดเฉลี่ยต่อบิล','Avg']].map(([label,key])=>`<div class="fcs-field"><span>${label}</span><div class="fcs-range"><input type="number" step="any" name="min${key}" placeholder="ขั้นต่ำ" aria-label="${label}ขั้นต่ำ"><span>ถึง</span><input type="number" step="any" name="max${key}" placeholder="สูงสุด" aria-label="${label}สูงสุด"></div></div>`).join('')}
                <label class="fcs-field"><span>ชื่อลูกค้า</span><input type="search" name="nameInput" placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อที่ต้องการค้นหา"></label>
              </div>
              <div class="fcs-actions"><button class="fcs-button fcs-primary" type="submit">ค้นหาลูกค้า</button><button class="fcs-button" type="button" id="fcs-reset">ล้างตัวกรอง</button><button class="fcs-button" type="button" id="fcs-selected">ดูรายการที่เลือก <span id="fcs-count">0</span></button></div>
              <div id="fcs-advanced-results" class="fcs-results"></div>
            </form>
            <section id="fcs-group" hidden><button class="fcs-button" type="button" id="fcs-back-group">‹ กลับผลค้นหา</button><div id="fcs-group-results" class="fcs-results"></div></section>
            <div id="fcs-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><button class="fcs-button" id="fcs-retry" type="button" hidden>ลองใหม่</button>
          </div>
          <footer class="fcs-footer"><button class="fcs-button fcs-mode-button" id="fcs-mode" type="button">ค้นหาแบบละเอียด <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></footer>
        </section>
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(host);
    const $=id=>host.querySelector('#fcs-'+id);
    let records=null,recordIndex=new Map(),rows=[],quickRows=[],selected=new Set(),mode='quick',opened=false,loading=false,previousFocus=null,profileFocus=null,profilePromise=null,searchTimer=null;
    const form=$('advanced');
    const profileOpen=()=>document.getElementById('scp-modal')?.classList.contains('open');
    const imageOpen=()=>document.getElementById('scp-image-viewer')?.classList.contains('open');
    const setStatus=text=>{$('status').textContent=text;};
    function switchMode(next){
      mode=next;host.dataset.mode=next;
      $('quick').hidden=next!=='quick';form.hidden=next!=='advanced';$('group').hidden=next!=='group';
      $('mode').hidden=next==='group';
      $('mode').innerHTML=next==='quick'?'ค้นหาแบบละเอียด <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>':'‹ กลับค้นหาเร็ว';
      $('title').textContent=next==='quick'?'ค้นหาลูกค้า':next==='advanced'?'ค้นหาแบบละเอียด':'รายการที่เลือก';
      $('subtitle').textContent=next==='quick'?'ค้นชื่อ แล้วแตะเพื่อดูรายละเอียด':next==='advanced'?'ตัวกรองและผลลัพธ์จาก Dashboard':'แตะชื่อเพื่อเปิดข้อมูลลูกค้า';
      $('body').scrollTop=0;
    }
    async function load(){
      loading=true;records=null;$('retry').hidden=true;setStatus('กำลังโหลดรายชื่อลูกค้า…');
      form.querySelector('[type=submit]').disabled=true;
      try{records=await engine.load();recordIndex=engine.indexRecords(records);setStatus('');if(mode==='quick')quickSearch();}
      catch(e){setStatus(e.message||'โหลดข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');$('retry').hidden=false;}
      finally{loading=false;form.querySelector('[type=submit]').disabled=!records;}
    }
    function open(){
      previousFocus=document.activeElement;opened=true;$('overlay').hidden=false;$('toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');document.body.classList.add('fcs-open');
      // The existing page menu should not remain underneath a second active dialog.
      const nav=document.getElementById('adminFloatingToggle');if(nav?.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true')nav.click();
      if(mode==='quick')$('name').focus();else $('dialog').focus();load();
    }
    function close(){
      if(profileOpen())return;
      opened=false;$('overlay').hidden=true;$('toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');document.body.classList.remove('fcs-open');previousFocus?.focus?.();
    }
    function contact(c){
      const phone=String(recordIndex.get(c.key)?.find(r=>String(r.phone??'').trim() && String(r.phone).trim()!=='-')?.phone??'').trim();
      const dial=phone.replace(/[\s().-]/g,'');
      const phoneHtml=/^\+?\d{6,15}$/.test(dial)
        ? `<a class="fcs-phone" href="tel:${dial}" aria-label="โทรหา ${esc(c.name)} ที่ ${esc(phone)}">☎ ${esc(phone)}</a>`
        : `<span class="fcs-phone-missing">${phone?esc(phone):'ไม่มีเบอร์โทร'}</span>`;
      return `<div class="fcs-contact"><span class="fcs-opd">OPD ${esc(c.opd||'-')}</span>${phoneHtml}</div>`;
    }
    function quickSearch(){
      if(!records)return;
      const q=$('name').value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if(!q){$('quick-results').innerHTML='<div class="fcs-empty">พิมพ์ชื่อเพื่อเริ่มค้นหา</div>';quickRows=[];setStatus('');return;}
      quickRows=engine.query(records,{nameInput:q});
      $('quick-results').innerHTML=quickRows.map((c,i)=>`<article class="fcs-quick-row"><button type="button" class="fcs-name customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(c.opd)}" data-quick="${i}">${esc(c.name)}</button>${contact(c)}</article>`).join('')||'<div class="fcs-empty">ไม่พบชื่อนี้ ลองพิมพ์ชื่ออีกครั้ง</div>';
      setStatus(quickRows.length?`พบ ${quickRows.length.toLocaleString()} คน`:'');
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.($('quick-results'));
    }
    function readFilters(){
      const f={nameInput:form.elements.nameInput.value.trim().toLowerCase(),startDate:form.elements.startDate.value,endDate:form.elements.endDate.value,selectedProducts:Array.from($('products').querySelectorAll('select')).map(s=>s.value).filter(Boolean)};
      for(const k of ['Total','Visits','Absent','Avg']){
        const parse=['Visits','Absent'].includes(k)?parseInt:parseFloat;
        f['min'+k]=parse(form.elements['min'+k].value)||0;f['max'+k]=parse(form.elements['max'+k].value)||Infinity;
      }
      return f;
    }
    function advancedSearch(){
      if(!records)return;
      rows=engine.query(records,readFilters());selected.clear();$('count').textContent='0';
      $('advanced-results').innerHTML=`<h3 class="fcs-result-heading">ผลลัพธ์ ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} คน</h3>`+rows.map((c,i)=>`<article class="fcs-result"><label class="fcs-check"><input type="checkbox" data-select="${i}" aria-label="เลือก ${esc(c.name)}"></label><div><button type="button" class="fcs-result-name customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(c.opd)}" data-result="${i}">📇 ${esc(c.name)}</button><div class="fcs-result-meta"><span>💰 ยอด: ${c.totalAmount.toLocaleString()}</span><span>💳 ${Math.round(c.averageBill).toLocaleString()}</span><span>🔁 ${c.totalVisits} (${c.paidVisits} จ่าย)</span><span>⏱️ ${c.absentDays} วัน</span><span>${esc(new Date(c.lastVisit).toLocaleDateString('th-TH',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'2-digit'}))}</span></div></div></article>`).join('');
      setStatus(rows.length?'':'ไม่พบลูกค้าที่ตรงกับเงื่อนไข');window.applyCustomerNameColors?.($('advanced-results'));
    }
    function addProduct(){
      const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='fcs-product-row';
      row.innerHTML=`<select aria-label="สินค้าที่เคยซื้อ"><option value="" selected disabled>เลือกสินค้าและบริการ</option>${Object.entries(engine.products).map(([cat,items])=>`<optgroup label="${esc(cat)}">${items.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p)}">${esc(p)}</option>`).join('')}</optgroup>`).join('')}</select><button class="fcs-button" type="button" aria-label="ลบตัวกรองสินค้านี้">ลบ</button>`;
      row.querySelector('button').onclick=()=>row.remove();$('products').appendChild(row);
    }
    function showSelected(){
      const customerIndex=engine.indexRecords(records||[]);
      $('group-results').innerHTML=rows.map((c,i)=>({c,i})).filter(({c})=>selected.has(c.key)).map(({c,i},n)=>{
        const latest=customerIndex.get(c.key)?.[0]||{};
        return `<article class="fcs-result"><div><button class="fcs-result-name" type="button" data-result="${i}">${n+1}. ${esc(c.name)}</button><div class="fcs-result-meta"><span>OPD: ${esc(c.opd||'-')}</span><span>📞 ${esc(latest.phone||'-')}</span><button class="fcs-button fcs-small" type="button" data-result="${i}">เปิดข้อมูล</button></div></div></article>`;
      }).join('')||'<div class="fcs-empty">ยังไม่ได้เลือกลูกค้า (ติ๊กช่องหน้าชื่อก่อน)</div>';
      setStatus('');switchMode('group');$('back-group').focus();
    }
    async function ensureProfile(){
      if(window.openCustomerProfile && document.getElementById('scp-modal'))return;
      if(profilePromise)return profilePromise;
      profilePromise=(async()=>{
        if(!document.getElementById('scp-modal')){
          const template=document.getElementById('fcs-profile-template');
          if(!template)throw new Error('ไม่พบหน้าต่างข้อมูลลูกค้า');
          document.body.appendChild(template.content.cloneNode(true));
        }
        if(!document.querySelector('link[href*="customer_profile_modal.css"]')){
          const css=document.createElement('link');css.rel='stylesheet';css.href=profileCSS;document.head.appendChild(css);
        }
        if(!window.openCustomerProfile){
          await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const s=document.createElement('script');s.src=profileJS;s.onload=resolve;s.onerror=()=>{s.remove();reject(new Error('โหลดหน้าต่างลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ ลองกดชื่ออีกครั้ง'));};document.body.appendChild(s);});
        }
      })();
      try{await profilePromise;}finally{profilePromise=null;}
    }
    async function detail(c,button){
      if(!c)return;profileFocus=button;button.disabled=true;
      try{
        await ensureProfile();
        const modal=document.getElementById('scp-modal');
        const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{
          if(!modal.classList.contains('open')){observer.disconnect();$('dialog').inert=false;document.body.classList.remove('fcs-profile-active');if(opened)profileFocus?.focus();}
        });
        observer.observe(modal,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
        $('dialog').inert=true;document.body.classList.add('fcs-profile-active');
        const result=window.openCustomerProfile(c.key);
        document.getElementById('scpCloseBtn')?.focus();await result;
      }catch(e){$('dialog').inert=false;document.body.classList.remove('fcs-profile-active');setStatus(e.message);}
      finally{button.disabled=false;}
    }
    $('toggle').onclick=open;$('retry').onclick=load;
    host.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=close);
    $('name').addEventListener('input',()=>{clearTimeout(searchTimer);searchTimer=setTimeout(quickSearch,180);});
    $('name').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();clearTimeout(searchTimer);quickSearch();}});
    $('mode').onclick=()=>{const next=mode==='quick'?'advanced':'quick';if(next==='advanced'&&!form.elements.nameInput.value)form.elements.nameInput.value=$('name').value;switchMode(next);setStatus('');if(next==='quick'){quickSearch();$('name').focus();}else form.elements.nameInput.focus();};
    $('add-product').onclick=addProduct;
    form.onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();advancedSearch();};
    $('reset').onclick=()=>{form.reset();$('products').replaceChildren();$('advanced-results').replaceChildren();rows=[];selected.clear();$('count').textContent='0';setStatus('');};
    $('selected').onclick=showSelected;$('back-group').onclick=()=>{switchMode('advanced');$('selected').focus();};
    host.addEventListener('change',e=>{const i=e.target.dataset.select;if(i===undefined)return;const key=rows[Number(i)]?.key;if(key){e.target.checked?selected.add(key):selected.delete(key);$('count').textContent=selected.size;}});
    host.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-quick],[data-result]');if(b)detail(b.dataset.quick!==undefined?quickRows[Number(b.dataset.quick)]:rows[Number(b.dataset.result)],b);});
    document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
      if(!opened)return;
      if(e.key==='Escape'){
        e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if(imageOpen()){document.getElementById('scpImageCloseBtn')?.click();return;}
        if(profileOpen()){window.closeCustomerProfile?.();return;}
        if(mode==='group'){switchMode('advanced');$('selected').focus();return;}
        close();return;
      }
      if(e.key==='Tab'){
        const active=imageOpen()?document.getElementById('scp-image-viewer'):profileOpen()?document.getElementById('scp-modal'):$('dialog');
        const list=Array.from(active.querySelectorAll('button:not(:disabled),input:not(:disabled),select:not(:disabled),textarea:not(:disabled),a[href],[tabindex="0"]')).filter(el=>el.getClientRects().length&&!el.closest('[hidden]'));
        const first=list[0],last=list.at(-1);if(!first){e.preventDefault();return;}
        if(e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===first||!active.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}
        else if(!e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===last||!active.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}
      }
    },true);
    switchMode('quick');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();

</script>
